lore.cartaddon.hito_hito_no_mi_model_ony: Human-Human Fruit, Model: Onyudo. Eaten by Onimaru, a fox retainer of Wano's Ringo region, granting the form of a towering monk yokai armed with a naginata and sword.
lore.cartaddon.hebi_hebi_no_mi_model_yam: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi. Eaten by Kurozumi Orochi, the shogun of Wano, granting an eight-headed serpent form and the extra heads to match.
lore.cartaddon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_bake_: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Bake-Danuki. Grants the shapeshifting form of a mischievous raccoon dog yokai, along with the ability to conjure phantom clones and transform leaves into useful tools.
lore.cartaddon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_kyubi: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Kyubi no Kitsune. Eaten by Catarina Devon of the Blackbeard Pirates, granting the form of a nine-tailed fox spirit.
lore.cartaddon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_okuch: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami. Eaten by Yamato, daughter of Kaido, granting the form of a guardian wolf deity.
lore.cartaddon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_tanuk: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Tanuki. 'Eaten' by Bunbuku, a teapot belonging to Tenguyama Hitetsu of Wano, giving it life as a raccoon dog.
lore.cartaddon.izou_kimono_bottom: The bottom half of the kimono worn by Izo, the 16th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.
lore.cartaddon.izou_kimono_top: The top half of the kimono worn by Izo of the Whitebeard Pirates, as sharp in style as he is with a blade.
lore.cartaddon.izou_sandals: The sandals worn by Izo, the Whitebeard Pirates' flamboyant swordsman and former Revolutionary Army agent.
lore.cartaddon.juku_juku_no_mi: Ripe-Ripe Fruit. Eaten by Shinobu, a kunoichi of the Kozuki Family, letting her ripen or wither anything she touches, people included.
lore.cartaddon.kibi_kibi_no_mi: Kibi-Kibi Fruit. Eaten by Tama of Wano, letting her befriend and control any animal that eats one of her dango.
lore.cartaddon.kumo_kumo_no_mi_model_ros: Spider-Spider Fruit, Model: Rosamygale Grauvogeli. Eaten by Black Maria of the Beasts Pirates, granting the form of a colossal ancient spider.
lore.cartaddon.leaf_axe: An axe conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability. Useful in a pinch, if only briefly.
lore.cartaddon.leaf_hoe: A hoe conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability, the humblest tool a Bake-Danuki can summon from thin air.
lore.cartaddon.leaf_pickaxe: A pickaxe conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability, courtesy of a Bake-Danuki's shapeshifting magic.
lore.cartaddon.leaf_shovel: A shovel conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability. As real as it needs to be, for as long as it's needed.
lore.cartaddon.leaf_sword: A blade conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability, a trick unique to Bake-Danuki transformees. Vanishes once its purpose is served.
lore.cartaddon.maki_maki_no_mi: Scroll-Scroll Fruit. Eaten by Raizo of the Nine Red Scabbards, letting him manifest and control mystical scrolls that can store objects, capture attacks, and generate lifelike drawings.
lore.cartaddon.mori_mori_no_mi: Forest-Forest Fruit. Eaten by Aramaki (Admiral Ryokugyu), letting him become, generate, and control forest vegetation, transforming into a massive golem of wood and foliage.
lore.cartaddon.neko_neko_no_mi_model_sab: Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Saber Tiger. Eaten by Who's Who of the Big Mom Pirates, granting the form of a prehistoric saber-toothed predator.
lore.cartaddon.riki_riki_no_mi: Strength-Strength Fruit. Eaten by Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates, granting monstrous physical strength capable of lifting and hurling entire mountains.
lore.cartaddon.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_pachy: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Pachycephalosaurus. Eaten by Ulti of the Beasts Pirates, granting a thick, bone-plated skull built for headbutting through anything.
lore.cartaddon.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_spino: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Spinosaurus. Eaten by Page One of the Beasts Pirates, granting the size and ferocity of a long-extinct apex predator.
lore.cartaddon.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_trice: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Triceratops. Eaten by Sasaki of the Beasts Pirates, granting a heavily armored, horned form built for devastating charges.
lore.cartaddon.tori_tori_no_mi_model_nue: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Nue. Eaten by Daifuku of the Big Mom Pirates, granting the form of a mythical chimera with the head of a monkey and body of a tiger.
lore.cartaddon.uo_uo_no_mi_model_seiryu: Fish-Fish Fruit, Model: Azure Dragon. Eaten by Kaido, the strongest creature in the world, granting the form of a colossal Eastern dragon.
lore.cartaddon.uta_uta_no_mi: Song-Song Fruit. Eaten by Uta, letting her trap listeners inside a world built from her music.
lore.cartaddon.wapu_wapu_no_mi: Warp-Warp Fruit. Eaten by Van Augur of the Blackbeard Pirates, letting him teleport himself and others instantaneously across short distances.
lore.mineminenomi.5t_hammer: A five-ton war hammer, far too heavy for any ordinary human to swing. Users with monstrous strength can use it to flatten enemies and fortifications alike.
lore.mineminenomi.ace: The legendary sword once wielded by Gol D. Roger, the Pirate King. Widely considered one of the strongest weapons in the game.
lore.mineminenomi.aces_hat: The wide-brimmed hat worn by Portgas D. Ace, marked with the Whitebeard Pirates' insignia. It was a signature piece of the fiery second division commander's outfit.
lore.mineminenomi.aces_knife: The curved dagger carried by Portgas D. Ace at his hip. A fast, light blade suited for close quarters rather than heavy combat.
lore.mineminenomi.ama_no_murakumo: A blade of solid light named after the legendary sword pulled from a slain serpent's tail. Conjured directly into its user's hand by a wielder of a light-based Devil Fruit, rather than carried.
lore.mineminenomi.ame_no_habakiri: One of the twelve legendary Saijo O Wazamono blades, named for a sword of Japanese myth said to repel rain. No single wielder is fixed to this blade; it awaits whoever proves themselves worthy.
lore.mineminenomi.ancient_manual: A weathered instructional text passed down through generations of martial artists. Studying it may reveal techniques long thought forgotten.
lore.mineminenomi.arlongs_hat: The hat worn by Arlong, the Fishman pirate captain who once ruled over Cocoyasi Village. Fishmen like him possess strength and durability far beyond an ordinary human's.
lore.mineminenomi.arlongs_pants: Part of the outfit worn by Arlong, the shark Fishman who terrorized the East Blue. Simple attire built to endure their wearer's immense strength.
lore.mineminenomi.arlongs_shirt: The sleeveless shirt worn by Arlong, baring the shark-like features of his Fishman heritage. Fishmen rarely need protective clothing, thanks to their natural toughness.
lore.mineminenomi.arlongs_shoes: Footwear worn by Arlong, though Fishmen need little protection for feet as durable as theirs. Kept more for appearance than necessity.
lore.mineminenomi.art_of_weather_trainer: Spawns an Art of Weather Trainer, an NPC who can teach the ways of the Weather-based fighting style. Seek them out to begin learning how to harness storms in battle.
lore.mineminenomi.awa_awa_no_mi: Bubble-Bubble Fruit. Eaten by Kalifa of CP9, letting her create slick, cleansing bubbles that strip away an opponent's strength and stamina.
lore.mineminenomi.axe: A bladed weapon built for combat rather than woodcutting. Slower than a sword, but capable of devastating blows.
lore.mineminenomi.axe_dial: A Dial that stores an axe swing, unleashing a sharp cutting force when activated. Popular among Skypiean warriors as a compact ranged weapon.
lore.mineminenomi.axe_hand: A hand-shaped attachment fitted with a blade, likely worn by a cyborg or prosthetic-limbed fighter. Doubles as a tool and a weapon in one.
lore.mineminenomi.baku_baku_no_mi: Munch-Munch Fruit. Eaten by Wapol, letting him devour anything and fuse it with his own body, taking on its shape and properties.
lore.mineminenomi.bananawani_spawn_egg: Spawns a Bananawani, a crocodile-like creature native to tropical seas. They're known for their powerful jaws and short, stubby legs.
lore.mineminenomi.bandana: A simple cloth worn around the head, favored by swordsmen and sailors alike to keep hair out of their eyes.
lore.mineminenomi.bandit_brute_spawn_egg: Spawns a Bandit Brute, a hulking enforcer among bandit gangs. Their raw strength makes them dangerous in close combat.
lore.mineminenomi.bandit_grunt_spawn_egg: Spawns a Bandit Grunt, a low-ranking member of a bandit gang. They're weaker than their superiors but often attack in numbers.
lore.mineminenomi.bandit_leader_spawn_eg: Spawns a Bandit Leader, the commanding figure of a bandit gang. They're tougher and better equipped than the grunts under their command.
lore.mineminenomi.bandit_sniper_spawn_eg: Spawns a Bandit Sniper, a bandit gang's ranged specialist. They prefer to strike from a distance rather than engage directly.
lore.mineminenomi.bane_bane_no_mi: Spring-Spring Fruit. Eaten by Bellamy, turning his legs into coiled springs capable of explosive jumps and bounding kicks.
lore.mineminenomi.bara_bara_no_mi: Chop-Chop Fruit. Eaten by Buggy, letting him split his body into separate floating pieces immune to cutting attacks.
lore.mineminenomi.bari_bari_no_mi: Barrier-Barrier Fruit. Eaten by Bartolomeo, letting him generate unbreakable barriers to block attacks or trap enemies.
lore.mineminenomi.barkeeper_spawn_egg: Spawns a Barkeeper, an NPC who runs a tavern and may share rumors or sell drinks. A good source of local gossip for traveling pirates and marines alike.
lore.mineminenomi.barrier: A translucent block of solidified energy. It can stop attacks and movement but shatters under enough pressure.
lore.mineminenomi.barrierbility_bat: A bat shaped from a hardened barrier, wielded as a blunt melee weapon. As sturdy as it looks, but only as durable as the barrier ability that formed it.
lore.mineminenomi.bastille_mask: A reinforced mask worn by guards of high-security prisons. It conceals the wearer's identity while protecting against smoke, gas, and blunt trauma.
lore.mineminenomi.bazooka: A shoulder-mounted launcher that fires explosive shells. Devastating against groups of enemies, but slow to reload.
lore.mineminenomi.belly_pouch: A small drawstring pouch used to carry Belly, the standard currency of the world. Pirates and merchants alike keep one on hand for quick transactions.
lore.mineminenomi.beta_beta_no_mi: Sticky-Sticky Fruit. Eaten by Trebol, letting him secrete a corrosive, adhesive mucus that traps and dissolves anything it touches.
lore.mineminenomi.bicorne: A two-cornered hat favored by naval officers and pirate captains of a bygone age. Its shape marks its wearer as someone of rank and authority.
lore.mineminenomi.big_red_nose: A comically oversized red nose, the trademark accessory of a certain clown-faced pirate captain. Purely cosmetic, but unmistakable from a mile away.
lore.mineminenomi.bisento: A heavy polearm topped with a broad, curved blade. Its weight makes each swing devastating, provided the wielder has the strength to keep up the momentum.
lore.mineminenomi.black_leg_trainer_spaw: Spawns a Black Leg Trainer, an NPC who teaches the kick-focused Black Leg fighting style. Their training rewards those who fight without ever using their hands.
lore.mineminenomi.blagori_spawn_egg: Spawns a Blagori, an aggressive creature found roaming the wilds. Best approached with caution.
lore.mineminenomi.blue_sword: A blade formed by igniting flammable gas trapped within a hollow hilt, a trick associated with users of gas-based Devil Fruits like Caesar Clown.
lore.mineminenomi.blugori_hood: A hood fashioned from the hide of a Blugori creature. Offers modest protection while blending its wearer into wooded surroundings.
lore.mineminenomi.blugori_spawn_egg: Spawns a Blugori, a wild creature that roams temperate regions. Its hide is sometimes harvested for crafting.
lore.mineminenomi.bomu_bomu_no_mi: Bomb-Bomb Fruit. Eaten by Mr. 5, letting his entire body, from breath to bodily fluids, explode on command.
lore.mineminenomi.bottle_of_rum: A bottle of strong pirate rum. A drink can raise one's spirits, though drinking too much brings its own consequences.
lore.mineminenomi.boxing_dugong_spawn_eg: Spawns a Boxing Dugong, an aquatic mammal trained to fight with its flippers. Surprisingly nimble for its bulky frame.
lore.mineminenomi.brawler_trainer_spawn_: Spawns a Brawler Trainer, an NPC who teaches unarmed combat techniques. Their lessons focus on raw punching power over finesse.
lore.mineminenomi.breath_dial: A Dial that stores a gust of compressed air, releasing it as a sudden burst of wind. Useful for propelling ships or knocking enemies off balance.
lore.mineminenomi.broadsword: A wide, heavy blade built for powerful two-handed swings. Slower than a rapier, but capable of cleaving through weaker weapons entirely.
lore.mineminenomi.bubbly_coral: A living coral formation that lets its holder breathe underwater. A prized find for anyone exploring the ocean depths without Fishman blood.
lore.mineminenomi.bullet: Standard ammunition for firearms. Fishmen and Longarm Tribe members aside, most who face a bullet won't enjoy the experience.
lore.mineminenomi.cabajis_scarf: The scarf worn by Cabaji, the acrobatic swordsman of the Buggy Pirates. He's rarely seen without his beloved unicycle nearby.
lore.mineminenomi.candy_block: A solid, oversized block of hardened candy. Sweet enough to attract insects, and sturdy enough to build with.
lore.mineminenomi.cannon: A ship-mounted weapon that fires heavy cannonballs at long range. Standard armament for any pirate or Marine vessel worth its salt.
lore.mineminenomi.cannon_ball: Ammunition fired from a cannon. A direct hit can cripple a ship's hull or scatter a crowd of enemies.
lore.mineminenomi.cat_claws: The retractable claws wielded by Captain Kuro of the Black Cat Pirates, capable of slicing through flesh with terrifying precision.
lore.mineminenomi.celestial_dragon_bubbl: A pressurized glass bubble worn over the head by the World Nobles, filtering out the air breathed by commoners. Wearing one marks its owner as untouchable by the world's laws.
lore.mineminenomi.celestial_dragon_spawn: Spawns a Celestial Dragon, a member of the world's ruling elite descended from the founders of the World Government. They wield near-limitless authority over ordinary citizens.
lore.mineminenomi.chakram: A flat, circular blade meant to be thrown or spun in melee. Its curved edge lets it slice from multiple angles in a single throw.
lore.mineminenomi.challenge_air: An invisible marker block used to define the boundaries of a combat challenge arena. It has no effect outside of that context.
lore.mineminenomi.challenge_poster: A poster listing the terms of a combat challenge. Reading it will let a willing fighter accept the trial within.
lore.mineminenomi.character_creator: A tool that opens the character customization menu. Use it to change your race, appearance, or fighting style.
lore.mineminenomi.chews_pants: Part of the outfit worn by Chew, the ink-spitting Fishman of the Arlong Pirates. Simple attire suited to an undersea lifestyle.
lore.mineminenomi.chews_shirt: The shirt worn by Chew, a Fishman crewmate of Arlong known for spraying ink at his enemies. Built to survive both land and sea.
lore.mineminenomi.chews_shoes: Footwear worn by Chew of the Arlong Pirates. Practical, if a bit unnecessary given his Fishman resilience.
lore.mineminenomi.chiyu_chiyu_no_mi: Heal-Heal Fruit. Eaten by Mansherry, letting her mend wounds and even reattach severed limbs through touch.
lore.mineminenomi.choppers_hat: The pink spotted hat worn by Tony Tony Chopper, the reindeer doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates. He wears it to hide the horn that marks him as no ordinary reindeer.
lore.mineminenomi.choppers_hat_2: A different hat worn by Tony Tony Chopper across his travels. Reindeer fashion, it seems, changes with the seasons.
lore.mineminenomi.cigar: A rolled tobacco leaf meant for smoking. A common vice among grizzled pirates and Marine officers alike.
lore.mineminenomi.cigarette: A thin roll of tobacco, favored by cooks and fighters who like to keep one lit between bouts of combat.
lore.mineminenomi.cleaver: A wide, heavy-bladed knife built for chopping through bone and thick meat. Just as effective against enemies as it is in the kitchen.
lore.mineminenomi.clima_tact: A collapsible staff wielded by Nami, the Straw Hat Pirates' navigator, and the signature weapon of the Weather fighting style. Its interchangeable Dials let her summon anything from fog to lightning.
lore.mineminenomi.cola: A carbonated drink that also serves as fuel for certain cyborg bodies. Refreshing to drink, and surprisingly useful in a pinch.
lore.mineminenomi.cola_backpack: A backpack rigged to store and dispense bottles of Cola. Built for cyborgs who need to refuel their bodies on the move.
lore.mineminenomi.color_palette: A palette of paint used to customize the color of wax clones and other constructs. Purely cosmetic, but handy for telling your doubles apart.
lore.mineminenomi.cooked_sea_king_meat: Meat from a Sea King, cooked to perfection. A rare delicacy, given how dangerous the creature is to hunt.
lore.mineminenomi.cp9_boots: Standard-issue boots worn by an agent of Cipher Pol Number 9. Built for the silent, swift movement expected of the World Government's elite assassins.
lore.mineminenomi.cp9_jacket: The formal jacket worn by an agent of Cipher Pol Number 9. Its polished appearance conceals a deadly master of assassination.
lore.mineminenomi.cp9_pants: Part of the uniform worn by Cipher Pol Number 9 agents. Practical attire suited to their brutal hand-to-hand fighting style.
lore.mineminenomi.crocodiles_pants: Part of the suit worn by Sir Crocodile, the sand-controlling Warlord and secret leader of Baroque Works. Sharp attire for a man who never breaks a sweat.
lore.mineminenomi.crocodiles_shoes: Footwear belonging to Sir Crocodile. Kept spotless, much like the rest of his carefully maintained appearance.
lore.mineminenomi.crocodiles_suit: The white suit worn by Sir Crocodile, draped beneath his signature pink fur coat. It's said he's never once been seen without it.
lore.mineminenomi.custom_spawner: A configurable spawner block that can be set to summon a chosen creature. Useful for building arenas or custom encounters.
lore.mineminenomi.cutlass: A curved, single-edged sword favored by sailors for its balance of reach and maneuverability in tight quarters. A pirate classic.
lore.mineminenomi.dagger: A short, easily concealed blade. Better suited to a quick strike than a prolonged duel.
lore.mineminenomi.daisenso: The weapon wielded by Don Krieg, captain of the Krieg Pirates armada.
lore.mineminenomi.daltons_spade: The bladed spade wielded by Dalton, a former lumberjack and Zoan hybrid ally of the Drum Kingdom. As much a farming tool as it is a weapon.
lore.mineminenomi.dandelion: A flower harvested from a devoted Straw Hat's Watering Can, imbued with the power to heal. Can be eaten for a modest amount of recovery.
lore.mineminenomi.darkness: A dense cloud of absolute void, drawn from the power of the Yami Yami no Mi. Anything caught within is pulled inward and crushed.
lore.mineminenomi.deepslate_kairoseki_or: Kairoseki ore found embedded in deepslate at deeper layers of the world. Just as effective at draining a Devil Fruit user's strength as its stone counterpart.
lore.mineminenomi.deka_deka_no_mi: Giant-Giant Fruit. Its user can grow to towering size, gaining overwhelming strength and reach at the cost of mobility.
lore.mineminenomi.demon_poison: A concentrated toxin drawn from the power of the Doku Doku no Mi. Even brief exposure can prove fatal.
lore.mineminenomi.den_den_mushi: A trained snail capable of transmitting sound across great distances, serving as the world's primary means of long-range communication. Every ship worth its salt carries one.
lore.mineminenomi.den_den_mushi_spawn_eg: Spawns a Den Den Mushi, a snail bred for its ability to relay sound and communication. Ships and towns alike rely on them to stay in contact.
lore.mineminenomi.dense_kairoseki: A denser, more potent form of Kairoseki. Its effects on Devil Fruit users are stronger than the standard ore.
lore.mineminenomi.design_barrel: A barrel used to customize the design of a crew's Jolly Roger flag. Every pirate crew needs a symbol to sail under.
lore.mineminenomi.devil_fruit_encycloped: A book that logs a player's discovered Devil Fruits and their history. Fills in over time as more fruits are encountered.
lore.mineminenomi.doa_doa_no_mi: Door-Door Fruit. Eaten by Blueno of CP9, letting him create passable doors on any surface, including thin air.
lore.mineminenomi.doctor_trainer_spawn_e: Spawns a Doctor Trainer, an NPC who teaches the Doctor fighting style. Their lessons focus on treating allies as much as fighting off enemies.
lore.mineminenomi.doflamingos_glasses: The heart-shaped sunglasses worn by Donquixote Doflamingo, the string-wielding Warlord and underworld broker. As flamboyant as the man himself.
lore.mineminenomi.doku_doku_no_mi: Venom-Venom Fruit. Eaten by Magellan, letting him generate and control nearly any form of poison, some strong enough to dissolve flesh outright.
lore.mineminenomi.doru_doru_arts_ken: A sword shaped from rapidly hardened wax, a technique associated with Mr. 3 (Galdino) and the power of the Doru Doru no Mi.
lore.mineminenomi.doru_doru_arts_pickaxe: A pickaxe shaped from hardened wax, the same technique used by Mr. 3 (Galdino) via the Doru Doru no Mi.
lore.mineminenomi.doru_doru_no_mi: Wax-Wax Fruit. Eaten by Mr. 3 (Galdino), letting him generate and instantly harden wax into weapons, armor, or entire structures.
lore.mineminenomi.durandal: A legendary blade named after the unbreakable sword of the paladin Roland. No confirmed original owner; whoever wields it inherits its reputation.
lore.mineminenomi.eisen_dial: A Dial infused with magnetic properties, capable of attracting or repelling metal objects. A useful tool for a blacksmith or a saboteur alike.
lore.mineminenomi.empty_cola: A drained bottle of Cola. Worthless as fuel, but can be refilled given the chance.
lore.mineminenomi.empty_ultra_cola: A drained bottle of Ultra Cola. Its potent fuel long since spent.
lore.mineminenomi.enma: A legendary black blade once wielded by Kozuki Oden, later carried by Roronoa Zoro. It drains the haki of anyone who wields it without sufficient mastery.
lore.mineminenomi.explosive_handcuffs: Restraints rigged with a hidden explosive charge. Meant to discourage prisoners from attempting escape.
lore.mineminenomi.extol_pouch: A pouch used to carry Extol, the currency used by the Skypieans of the sky islands. Rarely seen outside of the clouds.
lore.mineminenomi.fighting_fish_spawn_eg: Spawns a Fighting Fish, an aggressive aquatic creature known for attacking anything that enters its waters.
lore.mineminenomi.flag: A crew's Jolly Roger flag, flown from the mast to announce their identity and reputation to friend and foe alike.
lore.mineminenomi.flame_dial: A Dial that stores and releases a burst of fire. A favorite tool among Skypiean warriors who lack a fire-based Devil Fruit of their own.
lore.mineminenomi.flash_dial: A Dial that stores a blinding flash of light, useful for disorienting enemies. Can also serve as a compact source of illumination.
lore.mineminenomi.fleet_admirals_hat: The hat worn by the Fleet Admiral, the highest-ranking officer of the Marines. Its wearer commands the full might of the World Government's military.
lore.mineminenomi.flintlock: An old-fashioned single-shot pistol. Slow to reload, but reliable in the hands of a steady marksman.
lore.mineminenomi.fluffy_cape: A soft, feathered cape worn for warmth and style in equal measure. Popular among pirates who like to make an entrance.
lore.mineminenomi.flying_fish_spawn_egg: Spawns a Flying Fish, a fish capable of gliding short distances above the waves to escape predators.
lore.mineminenomi.frankys_glasses: The star-shaped sunglasses worn by Franky, the cyborg shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates. As iconic as his blue pompadour.
lore.mineminenomi.frankys_shirt: The open Hawaiian-style shirt worn by Franky. He prefers to let his cyborg chassis do most of the talking.
lore.mineminenomi.fruit_clue: A scrap of information hinting at the location or nature of a Devil Fruit. Piecing enough of them together may lead to a real discovery.
lore.mineminenomi.gamma_knife: A blade infused with radioactive energy, capable of tearing through an opponent's organs from a distance. Its exact origin among Devil Fruit users is unclear.
lore.mineminenomi.gasu_gasu_no_mi: Gas-Gas Fruit. Eaten by Caesar Clown, letting him turn his body to gas and manufacture toxic or flammable clouds at will.
lore.mineminenomi.generic_fruit: An unidentified Devil Fruit whose true power remains a mystery. Eating it will reveal what lies within, for better or worse.
lore.mineminenomi.ginga_pachinko: A specialized shot loaded into a slingshot, sending a projectile screaming through the air like a shooting star. A favorite trick of a certain long-nosed marksman.
lore.mineminenomi.goe_goe_no_mi: Boom-Boom Fruit. Eaten by El Drago, letting him unleash devastating sound waves through his voice.
lore.mineminenomi.golden_box: A finely crafted chest known to contain a Devil Fruit. Its golden trim marks it as holding the rarest possible find.
lore.mineminenomi.golden_den_den_mushi: A rare, golden-shelled Den Den Mushi capable of far greater communication range than its ordinary counterparts. Prized by those who need to reach across the world.
lore.mineminenomi.gomu_gomu_no_mi: Actually the mythical Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika in disguise, though it appears as the Gomu Gomu no Mi (Rubber-Rubber Fruit). Eaten by Monkey D. Luffy, granting a body of pure rubber immune to blunt force and electricity.
lore.mineminenomi.goro_goro_no_mi: Rumble-Rumble Fruit. Eaten by Enel, letting him become, generate, and control lightning, moving and striking at lightning speed.
lore.mineminenomi.gryphon: The sword wielded by Silvers Rayleigh, the 'Dark King' and former first mate of the Roger Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.gura_gura_no_mi: Tremor-Tremor Fruit. Wielded first by Edward Newgate (Whitebeard) and later by Marshall D. Teach (Blackbeard), letting its user generate quakes powerful enough to shatter the sea itself.
lore.mineminenomi.hana_hana_no_mi: Flower-Flower Fruit. Eaten by Nico Robin, letting her sprout copies of her own limbs on any surface she can see.
lore.mineminenomi.handcuffs: Standard restraints used to bind a captive's wrists together. Little more than a minor inconvenience for a determined Devil Fruit user.
lore.mineminenomi.hardened_snow: Snow compacted and hardened into a solid, ice-like material. Sturdy enough to build with, provided the temperature stays low.
lore.mineminenomi.hassaikai: The weapon wielded by Kaido, the strongest creature in the world and captain of the Beasts Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.heart: What a Ope Ope no Mi user tears from an opponent's chest with the Mes technique - a still-beating heart sealed in a glass-like cube, giving its holder total leverage over the person it was cut from.
lore.mineminenomi.heart_glasses: A pair of heart-shaped glasses, worn more for charm than protection. A favorite accessory of performers and idols.
lore.mineminenomi.hie_hie_no_mi: Ice-Ice Fruit. Eaten by Kuzan (Aokiji), letting him become, generate, and control ice, capable of freezing entire seas solid.
lore.mineminenomi.hiso_hiso_no_mi: Whisper-Whisper Fruit. Eaten by Apis, letting her understand and communicate directly with animals.
lore.mineminenomi.hito_hito_no_mi: Human-Human Fruit. Eaten by Tony Tony Chopper, granting the reindeer human intelligence and the ability to take on human and hybrid forms.
lore.mineminenomi.hito_hito_no_mi_model_: Human-Human Fruit, Model: Buddha. Eaten by Sengoku, letting him transform into an enormous golden Buddha.
lore.mineminenomi.hook: The golden hook worn by Sir Crocodile in place of his left hand. Coated with a paralyzing poison, making even a graze from it a serious threat.
lore.mineminenomi.horo_horo_no_mi: Hollow-Hollow Fruit. Eaten by Perona, letting her create ghosts that pass through solid matter and sap an opponent's will to fight.
lore.mineminenomi.horu_horu_no_mi: Hormone-Hormone Fruit. Eaten by Emporio Ivankov, letting him inject hormones that alter a target's body, from healing wounds to reshaping their form entirely.
lore.mineminenomi.humandrill_spawn_egg: Spawns a Humandrill, an unusually intelligent primate capable of fighting alongside or against humans.
lore.mineminenomi.ice_saber: Kuzan (Aokiji)'s signature technique: a blade of solidified ice formed around the leg for a devastating kick.
lore.mineminenomi.impact_dial: A Dial that stores kinetic force from an impact, releasing it back with equal or greater power. A favorite among Skypiean warriors for redirecting an enemy's own strength against them.
lore.mineminenomi.iron_box: A sturdy iron-bound chest known to contain a Devil Fruit. Tougher than its wooden counterpart, though not quite as prized as the golden variety.
lore.mineminenomi.iron_jaw: A prosthetic or reinforced jaw made of solid iron. Grants a bite far stronger than flesh and bone alone could manage.
lore.mineminenomi.ito_ito_no_mi: String-String Fruit. Eaten by Donquixote Doflamingo, letting him generate razor-sharp strings capable of cutting steel or puppeteering another person's body.
lore.mineminenomi.jiki_jiki_no_mi: Magnet-Magnet Fruit. Eaten by Eustass Kid, letting him attract, repel, and reshape metal at will.
lore.mineminenomi.jitte: A truncheon-like weapon with a single side prong, traditionally used to catch and disarm an opponent's blade. A favorite of a certain smoke-wielding Marine.
lore.mineminenomi.kabuto: A slingshot capable of firing a variety of ammunition with pinpoint accuracy. The signature weapon of a certain long-nosed sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.kachi_kachi_no_mi: Hard-Hard Fruit. Eaten by Bear King from the second One Piece film, letting the user raise their body temperature to harden their body like stone.
lore.mineminenomi.kage_kage_no_mi: Shadow-Shadow Fruit. Eaten by Gecko Moria, letting him steal shadows and reattach them to grant their properties to a new body.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki: Sea Stone, a rare mineral that saps the strength of Devil Fruit users and renders their powers useless. The Marines and World Government rely on it to imprison the most dangerous of pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki_bars: Prison bars forged from Kairoseki. Even the strongest Devil Fruit user finds themselves powerless within a cell lined with these.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki_block: A solid building block of Kairoseki. Useful for constructing prisons meant to hold Devil Fruit users.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki_bullet: A bullet forged from Kairoseki. On top of the wound it inflicts, it also saps the strength of any Devil Fruit user it strikes.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki_handcuffs: Restraints lined with Kairoseki, designed specifically to neutralize a Devil Fruit user's powers while bound. A common sight aboard Marine transport ships.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki_item: An item forged partly from Kairoseki. Handling it saps the strength of any nearby Devil Fruit user.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki_net: A net woven with threads of Kairoseki. Anyone caught within finds their Devil Fruit powers rendered useless until they break free.
lore.mineminenomi.kairoseki_ore: Raw, unrefined Kairoseki ore. Requires smelting before it can be shaped into bars, blocks, or restraints.
lore.mineminenomi.kame_kame_no_mi: Turtle-Turtle Fruit. Its user gains a hardened shell capable of shrugging off powerful blows.
lore.mineminenomi.karu_karu_no_mi: Karma Fruit. Modeled after Mad Monk Urouge's unnamed Devil Fruit, letting the user convert damage they've taken into raw physical strength.
lore.mineminenomi.katana: A curved, single-edged Japanese sword prized for its sharpness and balance. The weapon of choice for any dedicated swordsman.
lore.mineminenomi.key: A simple key used to unlock a chest. Unlocking a chest gets you devil fruit.
lore.mineminenomi.kikoku: The black-bladed nodachi wielded by Trafalgar Law, captain of the Heart Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.killers_mask: The mask worn by Killer, the scythe-wielding first mate of the Kid Pirates. Its jagged design is as intimidating as the man beneath it.
lore.mineminenomi.kilo_kilo_no_mi: Kilo-Kilo Fruit. Eaten by Miss Valentine, letting her adjust her own weight from feather-light to crushingly heavy.
lore.mineminenomi.kira_kira_no_mi: Glitter-Glitter Fruit. Eaten by Jozu, letting him turn his body into unbreakable diamond.
lore.mineminenomi.kiribachi: The massive, saw-toothed cleaver wielded by Arlong, the shark Fishman pirate captain. Built to tear through flesh and hull alike.
lore.mineminenomi.kizarus_glasses: The sunglasses worn by Admiral Kizaru, the light-footed Marine officer known for his laid-back demeanor. He rarely seems to take anything seriously, least of all combat.
lore.mineminenomi.kobu_kobu_no_mi: The Kobu Kobu no Mi allows the user to awaken the latent strength of others by encouraging them. It was eaten by Belo Betty.
lore.mineminenomi.kuja_bow: A bow crafted by the Kuja Tribe of Amazon Lily, the all-female warrior society led by Boa Hancock.
lore.mineminenomi.kuku_kuku_no_mi: Cook-Cook Fruit. Eaten by Streusen, the head chef of the Big Mom Pirates, letting him turn anything into food.
lore.mineminenomi.kuma_boots: Part of the outfit worn by Bartholomew Kuma, the Warlord known as the Tyrant. Simple, sturdy footwear for a man who rarely needs to move quickly.
lore.mineminenomi.kuma_pants: Trousers worn by Bartholomew Kuma. Plain in design, much like the rest of his monk-like attire.
lore.mineminenomi.kuma_shirt: The shirt worn beneath Bartholomew Kuma's coat. Unassuming clothing for one of the most feared men in the world.
lore.mineminenomi.kung_fu_dugong_spawn_e: Spawns a Kung Fu Dugong, an aquatic mammal trained in a striking martial art. Don't let its round shape fool you.
lore.mineminenomi.kuro_kabuto: A blackened variant of the classic slingshot, built for greater power at the cost of some accuracy. Favored by marksmen who prefer force over finesse.
lore.mineminenomi.kuroobis_ki: A martial arts uniform belonging to Kuroobi, the karate-practicing Fishman of the Arlong Pirates. Its black belt marks him as a master of his craft.
lore.mineminenomi.kuroobis_pants: Part of the karate uniform worn by Kuroobi. Loose enough to allow for his devastating kicks.
lore.mineminenomi.kuroobis_shoes: Footwear worn by Kuroobi, though most of his combat style relies on bare feet and open-palm strikes.
lore.mineminenomi.kuros_glasses: The clawed glasses worn by Captain Kuro of the Black Cat Pirates. Hidden blades extend from the frame's edges when needed.
lore.mineminenomi.kuros_pants: Part of the butler disguise worn by Captain Kuro during his years posing as a servant. A convincing costume concealing a dangerous assassin.
lore.mineminenomi.kuros_shoes: Footwear from Captain Kuro's butler disguise. Silent enough to suit a man who prefers to strike without warning.
lore.mineminenomi.kuros_suit: The formal butler's suit worn by Captain Kuro while hiding in plain sight. Beneath its polished exterior lurks one of the era's most dangerous killers.
lore.mineminenomi.lapahn_spawn_egg: Spawns a Lapahn, a large rabbit-like creature found roaming snowy or wooded regions.
lore.mineminenomi.laws_hat: The spotted white hat worn by Trafalgar Law, captain of the Heart Pirates. Rarely seen without it, even during his most dangerous operations.
lore.mineminenomi.legendary_master_dugon: Spawns a Legendary Master Dugong, an elder among its kind and a formidable martial artist in its own right. Said to have trained many fighters in its time.
lore.mineminenomi.lollipop: A swirled candy on a stick, sweet enough to satisfy any craving. Popular among those with a taste for sugary weapons as much as sugary snacks.
lore.mineminenomi.luffys_pants: The cutoff shorts worn by Monkey D. Luffy, captain of the Straw Hat Pirates. Practical and rarely changed no matter how far his journey takes him.
lore.mineminenomi.luffys_sandals: The simple sandals worn by Monkey D. Luffy. Built for a man who spends more time punching than walking carefully.
lore.mineminenomi.luffys_shirt: The red, open vest worn by Monkey D. Luffy. Iconic attire for the man who dreams of becoming King of the Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.mace: A blunt weapon topped with a heavy, studded head. Built to crush armor rather than cut through it.
lore.mineminenomi.magu_magu_no_mi: Magma-Magma Fruit. Eaten by Sakazuki (Akainu), letting him become and control magma hot enough to incinerate flesh instantly.
lore.mineminenomi.mangrove_leaves: Leaves harvested from a Mangrove tree, the kind found rooted in the shallow, brackish waters near Fishman Island.
lore.mineminenomi.mangrove_log: A log cut from a Mangrove tree. Its wood is well-suited to construction near coastlines and swamps.
lore.mineminenomi.mangrove_planks: Planks cut from Mangrove wood. A sturdy building material favored in coastal and underwater settlements.
lore.mineminenomi.mangrove_wood: A solid block of Mangrove wood, bark and all. Common in the swampy waters surrounding Fishman Island.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_boots: Standard-issue boots worn by rank-and-file Marine soldiers. Built for long patrols rather than comfort.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_brute_spawn_egg: Spawns a Marine Brute, a hulking enforcer within the Marine ranks. Their raw strength makes up for what they lack in finesse.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_captain_cape: A cape worn by a Marine Captain, marking their rank to friend and foe alike. Its wearer commands a company of Marine soldiers.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_captain_spawn_e: Spawns a Marine Captain, a mid-ranking officer who commands a group of Marine soldiers. Tougher and better trained than the average grunt.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_grunt_spawn_egg: Spawns a Marine Grunt, a low-ranking Marine soldier. Individually weak, but dangerous when they attack as a group.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_hat: The standard cap worn by Marine soldiers, marked with the seagull insignia of the World Government's naval force.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_pants: Standard-issue trousers worn as part of a Marine uniform. Built for durability over comfort.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_shirt: The blue uniform shirt worn by rank-and-file Marine soldiers, bearing the mark of justice they've sworn to uphold.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_sniper_spawn_eg: Spawns a Marine Sniper, a ranged specialist within the Marine ranks. They prefer to strike from a safe distance.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_trader_spawn_eg: Spawns a Marine Trader, an NPC who deals in goods and equipment tied to the World Government's forces.
lore.mineminenomi.marine_vice_admiral_sp: Spawns a Marine Vice Admiral, a high-ranking officer with considerable authority and combat skill. Far more dangerous than the soldiers under their command.
lore.mineminenomi.medic_bag: A satchel of medical supplies used to treat injuries in the field. Its contents can be sacrificed to fuel a more powerful healing effect.
lore.mineminenomi.mera_mera_no_mi: Flame-Flame Fruit. Wielded first by Portgas D. Ace and later by his brother Sabo, letting its user become, generate, and control fire.
lore.mineminenomi.mero_mero_no_mi: Love-Love Fruit. Eaten by Boa Hancock, letting her turn anyone infatuated with her to stone.
lore.mineminenomi.mh5_gas_mask: A mask designed to filter out the deadly gas released by the MH5 technique. Without one, exposure to the poison cloud is almost always fatal.
lore.mineminenomi.mihawks_hat: The wide-brimmed hat worn by Dracule Mihawk, widely regarded as the world's greatest swordsman. He wears it even in the heat of battle.
lore.mineminenomi.mihawks_knife: A small knife carried by Dracule Mihawk, used almost mockingly against opponents he considers beneath his true blade. Even his lesser weapon is a serious threat.
lore.mineminenomi.milky_dial: A Dial that stores and releases a thick cloud of white mist. Useful for concealment or disorienting nearby enemies.
lore.mineminenomi.mini_mini_no_mi: A Devil Fruit that lets the user shrink their body down to a fraction of its normal size.
lore.mineminenomi.mochi_mochi_no_mi: Mochi-Mochi Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Katakuri, letting him generate and control mochi with properties close to a Logia despite technically being a Paramecia.
lore.mineminenomi.mogu_mogu_no_mi: Mole-Mole Fruit. Eaten by Miss Merry Christmas, granting powerful digging claws and a talent for tunneling.
lore.mineminenomi.mogura: The trident wielded by Charlotte Katakuri, one of the strongest commanders of the Big Mom Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.moku_moku_no_mi: Smoke-Smoke Fruit. Eaten by Smoker, letting him become and control smoke, making his body nearly impossible to strike.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_1s_pants: Part of the suit worn by Mr. 1, the blade-bodied assassin of Baroque Works. Tailored to accommodate his unusual anatomy.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_1s_shirt: The dress shirt worn by Mr. 1, an elite agent of Baroque Works whose entire body can turn to steel. Formal wear hiding a lethal weapon.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_1s_shoes: Footwear worn by Mr. 1. Sharp enough dressing for a man who considers himself a walking blade.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_3s_glasses: The glasses worn by Mr. 3, the wax-wielding agent of Baroque Works. He sees the world a bit differently than most.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_3s_pants: Part of the suit worn by Mr. 3. Neatly pressed, much like the wax constructs he prides himself on.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_3s_shirt: The shirt worn by Mr. 3, an agent of Baroque Works who takes great pride in his artistic wax creations.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_3s_shoes: Footwear worn by Mr. 3. Practical, if a little dull compared to his more elaborate wax sculptures.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_5s_glasses: The glasses worn by Mr. 5, the explosive-bodied agent of Baroque Works. He rarely goes anywhere without something ready to detonate.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_5s_pants: Part of the suit worn by Mr. 5. Durable enough to survive its wearer's more explosive tendencies.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_5s_shirt: The shirt worn by Mr. 5, an agent of Baroque Works whose entire body can be turned into a bomb. Handle with more caution than the fabric suggests.
lore.mineminenomi.mr_5s_shoes: Footwear worn by Mr. 5. Sturdy, though probably not blast-proof.
lore.mineminenomi.mucus: A thick, corrosive slime drawn from the power of the Beta Beta no Mi. Sticky enough to trap, and dangerous enough to burn.
lore.mineminenomi.murakumogiri: The massive bisento wielded by Edward Newgate (Whitebeard), once considered the strongest man in the world.
lore.mineminenomi.nagi_nagi_no_mi: Calm-Calm Fruit. Eaten by Donquixote Rosinante (Corazon), letting him silence all sound within a chosen radius.
lore.mineminenomi.neko_neko_no_mi_model_: Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Leopard. Eaten by Rob Lucci, granting exceptional speed and agility in his hybrid and full transformations.
lore.mineminenomi.netsu_netsu_no_mi: Heat-Heat Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Oven, letting him radiate and channel intense heat through touch.
lore.mineminenomi.nidai_kitetsu: The second blade in the cursed Kitetsu line. No fixed wielder is recorded, though its curse is said to bring misfortune to anyone who carries it without resolve.
lore.mineminenomi.nikyu_nikyu_no_mi: Paw-Paw Fruit. Eaten by Bartholomew Kuma, letting him repel anything he touches, including pain, air, and people, launching them with tremendous force.
lore.mineminenomi.nonosama_staff: A ceremonial staff tied to Skypiean religious tradition, associated with worship of the Nono, the golden bell said to represent Skypiea's god.
lore.mineminenomi.nonosama_trident: A trident tied to Skypiean nobility's claim over the sky islands, associated with the same religious tradition as the Nonosama Staff.
lore.mineminenomi.noro_noro_beam_sword: A blade formed by focusing photon energy inside a hollow hilt, courtesy of Foxy's Slow-Slow Fruit. Anyone struck by it is slowed to a crawl.
lore.mineminenomi.noro_noro_no_mi: Slow-Slow Fruit. Eaten by Foxy, letting him fire a photon beam that drastically slows anything it strikes.
lore.mineminenomi.oil_spill: A slick puddle of spilled oil. Makes footing treacherous for anyone unlucky enough to stand in it, especially near an open flame.
lore.mineminenomi.ope: The verbal cue Trafalgar Law shouts when manipulating objects and people within his ROOM, courtesy of the Ope Ope no Mi.
lore.mineminenomi.ope_ope_no_mi: Op-Op Fruit. Eaten by Trafalgar Law, letting him create a spherical ROOM in which he can freely manipulate the position of everything inside, including performing otherwise-impossible surgery.
lore.mineminenomi.ori_bars: Sturdy cage bars, often used to construct makeshift prisons. Simple, but effective at keeping something contained.
lore.mineminenomi.ori_ori_no_mi: A Devil Fruit that lets the user generate cages capable of trapping anything they enclose.
lore.mineminenomi.oto_oto_no_mi: Sound-Sound Fruit. Its user can manipulate sound as a physical weapon, using music to heal allies or devastate enemies.
lore.mineminenomi.pacifista_spawn_egg: Spawns a Pacifista, a Marine cyborg weapon modeled after the Warlord Bartholomew Kuma. Built to withstand and return devastating firepower.
lore.mineminenomi.panda_shark_spawn_egg: Spawns a Panda Shark, an unusual hybrid creature found in the waters of the Grand Line. As dangerous as it is bizarre-looking.
lore.mineminenomi.pearl_body_armor: Armor worn by Pearl, the heavily armored member of Don Krieg's crew. Its thick plating makes him nearly impossible to wound with conventional weapons.
lore.mineminenomi.pearl_head_armor: A helmet worn by Pearl of the Krieg Pirates. Part of a suit of armor said to be nearly indestructible.
lore.mineminenomi.pearl_legs_armor: Leg armor worn by Pearl of the Krieg Pirates. Heavy, but it has yet to fail its wearer in battle.
lore.mineminenomi.perfect_clima_tact: An upgraded Clima Tact used by Nami, refined to draw out even more devastating Weather-style Tempos than the original.
lore.mineminenomi.pero_pero_no_mi: Candy-Candy Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Perospero, letting him create and control candy, coating or transforming anything he touches into rock-hard sugar.
lore.mineminenomi.pika_pika_no_mi: Glint-Glint Fruit. Eaten by Borsalino (Kizaru), letting him become, generate, and control light, moving and attacking at the speed of light.
lore.mineminenomi.pipe: A smoking pipe, favored by those who prefer a slower smoke than a rolled cigarette.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_boots: Standard footwear worn by rank-and-file pirates. Worn but reliable, much like the crews who wear them.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_brute_spawn_egg: Spawns a Pirate Brute, a hulking enforcer among a pirate crew. Their strength alone can be enough to end a fight quickly.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_captain_cape: A cape worn by a pirate captain, marking their authority over their crew. Every captain wears theirs a little differently.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_captain_spawn_e: Spawns a Pirate Captain, the commanding figure of a pirate crew. Stronger and better equipped than the crew members serving under them.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_grunt_spawn_egg: Spawns a Pirate Grunt, a low-ranking member of a pirate crew. Weak alone, but dangerous when they gang up.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_notorious_capta: Spawns a Notorious Pirate Captain, a pirate with a bounty large enough to draw the attention of the Marines. Considerably more dangerous than an ordinary captain.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_pants: Standard trousers worn by rank-and-file pirates. Patched and worn from a life at sea.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_shirt: A simple shirt worn by rank-and-file pirates. Rarely matches from one crew member to the next.
lore.mineminenomi.pirate_trader_spawn_eg: Spawns a Pirate Trader, an NPC dealing in goods favored by pirate crews. Their prices tend to reflect their questionable business practices.
lore.mineminenomi.plume_hat: A hat topped with an elegant feather plume. Popular among nobles and flamboyant pirates alike.
lore.mineminenomi.poison: A hazardous toxic substance. Contact or inhalation can cause serious harm over time.
lore.mineminenomi.poneglyph: An indestructible stone tablet carved with ancient text, said to record the true history the World Government has worked to erase. Only a select few can read its inscriptions.
lore.mineminenomi.pop_green: A seed-based explosive projectile, capable of sprouting into carnivorous plants on impact. A favorite trick of a certain Straw Hat sniper.
lore.mineminenomi.reject_dial: A Dial that stores and reflects any impact directed at it, sending the force right back at its attacker. Dangerous to use against an opponent who knows what it does.
lore.mineminenomi.road_poneglyph: One of four special Poneglyphs said to reveal the location of Laugh Tale, the one true legendary island. Each must be found and deciphered to complete the map.
lore.mineminenomi.rope_net: A woven net used to entangle and capture a target. Simple, but effective against anyone caught off guard.
lore.mineminenomi.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_al: Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Allosaurus. Eaten by X Drake, granting the raw ferocity of a long-extinct predator.
lore.mineminenomi.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_br: Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Brachiosaurus. Eaten by Queen of the Beasts Pirates, granting the massive size and near-unstoppable defense of a long-extinct herbivore.
lore.mineminenomi.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_pt: Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Pteranodon. Eaten by King of the Beasts Pirates, granting the gift of flight alongside a prehistoric predator's ferocity.
lore.mineminenomi.sabi_sabi_no_mi: Rust-Rust Fruit. Eaten by Shu, letting him spread corrosive rust through touch, crumbling any metal it spreads across.
lore.mineminenomi.sabos_hat: The tall top hat worn by Sabo, chief of staff of the Revolutionary Army and adopted brother of Ace and Luffy. He rarely takes it off, even in the heat of battle.
lore.mineminenomi.sai_sai_no_mi: A Devil Fruit that grants a hybrid or full rhinoceros form, along with a thick hide and devastating charging attack.
lore.mineminenomi.sake_bottle: A bottle of rice wine, favored by drinkers across the seas of Wano and beyond.
lore.mineminenomi.sake_cup: A small cup used for drinking sake. Often refilled long before it's ever truly empty.
lore.mineminenomi.samekiri_bocho: A specialized cleaver traditionally used to butcher sharks and other large sea creatures. A practical tool for any cook working near the sea.
lore.mineminenomi.sandai_kitetsu: The third blade in the cursed Kitetsu line, wielded by Roronoa Zoro despite its curse.
lore.mineminenomi.sanjis_pants: The pinstriped trousers worn by Sanji, the Straw Hat Pirates' cook. Practical enough to keep up with his kick-based fighting style.
lore.mineminenomi.sanjis_shirt: The black suit worn by Sanji, complete with his signature curled eyebrow left uncovered. Sharp attire for a man who never fights with his hands.
lore.mineminenomi.sanjis_shoes: The dress shoes worn by Sanji. Reinforced enough to withstand the devastating kicks of the Black Leg style.
lore.mineminenomi.sara_sara_no_mi_model_: A Devil Fruit granting a hybrid or full axolotl form, with strong regenerative abilities and a talent for swimming.
lore.mineminenomi.scissors: A massive pair of scissors wielded by Gecko Moria, the shadow-stealing Warlord of the Seven.
lore.mineminenomi.sea_cow_spawn_egg: Spawns a Sea Cow, a docile aquatic mammal often kept as livestock in coastal communities.
lore.mineminenomi.sea_king_meat: Raw meat harvested from a Sea King, one of the ocean's most fearsome giant creatures. Cooking it first is highly recommended.
lore.mineminenomi.senor_pinks_bonnet: The oversized baby bonnet worn by Senor Pink, an officer of the Donquixote Family. His childlike appearance hides a genuinely dangerous fighter.
lore.mineminenomi.senor_pinks_diaper: The armored diaper worn by Senor Pink. As absurd as it looks, it's tough enough to withstand a real fight.
lore.mineminenomi.senor_pinks_shirt: The baby-style shirt worn by Senor Pink. Part of an outfit chosen to unsettle opponents as much as protect him.
lore.mineminenomi.senriku: A long-barreled gun prized for its range and accuracy, capable of striking targets far outside melee reach.
lore.mineminenomi.shadow: A shadow stolen by a user of the Kage Kage no Mi, such as Gecko Moria. Reattaching it to a new body or object grants that shadow's properties, while its original owner grows powerless in direct sunlight.
lore.mineminenomi.shusui: A legendary black blade of Wano origin, once wielded by the swordsman Ryuma before it was taken from his grave. Later claimed by Roronoa Zoro.
lore.mineminenomi.sky_block: A solid block formed from the compressed clouds of the sky islands. Sturdy enough to walk and build on, despite its wispy appearance.
lore.mineminenomi.skypiean_civilian_spaw: Spawns a Skypiean Civilian, a resident of the floating sky islands. Most are peaceful and simply going about their lives above the clouds.
lore.mineminenomi.skypiean_trader_spawn_: Spawns a Skypiean Trader, an NPC dealing in goods and currency unique to the sky islands.
lore.mineminenomi.smoker_boots: Standard boots worn by Smoker, the smoke-controlling Marine officer known for his relentless pursuit of pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.smoker_jacket: The white coat worn by Smoker. He's rarely seen without a lit cigar to match his smoky Devil Fruit power.
lore.mineminenomi.smoker_pants: Part of the uniform worn by Smoker. Simple, practical attire for a Marine who spends most of his time chasing down criminals.
lore.mineminenomi.smoking_pipe: A smoking pipe favored by seasoned pirates and sailors. A slower, more contemplative smoke than a rolled cigarette.
lore.mineminenomi.sniper_goggles: Goggles that improve accuracy for anyone using a ranged weapon. Especially useful for lining up a shot from extreme distances.
lore.mineminenomi.sniper_trainer_spawn_e: Spawns a Sniper Trainer, an NPC who teaches the ranged-focused Sniper fighting style. Their lessons emphasize patience and precision above all else.
lore.mineminenomi.sogeking_mask: The mask worn by Sogeking, the masked marksman alter-ego of Usopp. Adopted to hide his identity during the daring raid on Enies Lobby.
lore.mineminenomi.sorcery_clima_tact: A further upgraded Clima Tact wielded by Nami, capable of channeling the most powerful Tempos the Weather fighting style has to offer.
lore.mineminenomi.soul_king_crown: A crown referencing Brook's title as the Soul King, earned through his music. Wearing it grants none of his skill, only the look.
lore.mineminenomi.soul_solid: The blade wielded by Brook, the skeletal musician of the Straw Hat Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.spear: A long-hafted weapon topped with a piercing blade. Favored for its reach against enemies who prefer to keep their distance.
lore.mineminenomi.sponge_cake: A soft, spongy cake block, the kind of terrain found across the sweets-covered island of Whole Cake Island.
lore.mineminenomi.straw_doll: A doll fashioned in the likeness of its target, capable of absorbing damage meant for them. Whoever holds the real target's fate should be careful with it.
lore.mineminenomi.straw_hat: A simple straw hat, worn by generations of pirates who dreamed of freedom on the open sea. Its most famous owner wears it as a promise to return it one day.
lore.mineminenomi.striker: A small, fast Marine patrol boat used for quick pursuit and boarding actions. Favored for chasing down fleeing pirate vessels.
lore.mineminenomi.string_wall: A wall woven from unbreakable strings, courtesy of the Ito Ito no Mi. Sturdy enough to block most attacks outright.
lore.mineminenomi.stripped_mangrove_log: A Mangrove log with its bark removed. Ready to be processed into planks or wood blocks.
lore.mineminenomi.stripped_mangrove_wood: A full block of Mangrove wood with its bark stripped away. A cleaner-looking alternative to the natural log.
lore.mineminenomi.structure_air: An invisible marker block used to define the boundaries of a generated structure. It has no effect outside of world generation.
lore.mineminenomi.sube_sube_no_mi: A Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that makes the user's skin perfectly smooth, causing attacks to slip off harmlessly. Physical strikes become almost useless against its user.
lore.mineminenomi.sui_sui_no_mi: Swim-Swim Fruit. Eaten by Senor Pink, an officer of the Donquixote Family, letting him swim through any solid surface as if it were water.
lore.mineminenomi.suke_suke_no_mi: Clear-Clear Fruit. Eaten by Absalom, turning his entire body invisible.
lore.mineminenomi.suna_sand: Sand drawn from the deserts of Alabasta, or created by the power of the Suna Suna no Mi. Useful for building or for burying an unfortunate enemy.
lore.mineminenomi.suna_suna_no_mi: Sand-Sand Fruit. Eaten by Sir Crocodile, letting him become and control sand, drying out anything he touches.
lore.mineminenomi.supa_supa_no_mi: Spike-Spike Fruit. Eaten by Mr. 1 (Daz Bones), turning his entire body into living steel blades.
lore.mineminenomi.super_spotbilled_duck_: Spawns a Super Spot-Billed Duck, a large and unusually tough species of waterfowl found in the Grand Line.
lore.mineminenomi.swordsman_trainer_spaw: Spawns a Swordsman Trainer, an NPC who teaches the blade-focused Swordsman fighting style. Their lessons reward patience and precision with the sword.
lore.mineminenomi.tabira_yuki: A blade formed from solid, hardened snow, courtesy of Monet's Snow-Snow Fruit. Anyone struck by it risks a lingering frostbite.
lore.mineminenomi.tangerine: A sweet citrus fruit, grown in groves tended with great care. Said to grow especially well in a certain navigator's home village.
lore.mineminenomi.tangerine_crop: A young tangerine tree, still growing toward the fruit it will eventually bear. Needs time and care before it can be harvested.
lore.mineminenomi.three_cigars: A bundle of three lit cigars, held together and smoked all at once. A habit favored by a certain relentless Marine officer.
lore.mineminenomi.tomoe_drums: A pair of hand drums used to keep rhythm in battle. Their steady beat can be as much a weapon as a form of music.
lore.mineminenomi.tonfa: A short, side-handled club used for both blocking and striking. Favored by fighters who prize speed and control over raw power.
lore.mineminenomi.tori_tori_no_mi_model_: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Phoenix. Eaten by Marco, granting regenerative blue flames capable of healing both himself and others.
lore.mineminenomi.tricorne: A three-cornered hat favored by naval officers and pirate captains of a bygone era. A mark of authority as much as fashion.
lore.mineminenomi.ultra_cola: A more potent variant of Cola, capable of providing a greater fuel boost to a cyborg body. Rare and expensive compared to the standard bottle.
lore.mineminenomi.umbrella: A folding umbrella, useful for staying dry, floating gently to the ground, or blocking a surprise attack.
lore.mineminenomi.unicycle: A single-wheeled cycle requiring impressive balance to ride. The signature vehicle of a certain acrobatic swordsman of the Buggy Pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.ushi_ushi_no_mi_model_: Cow-Cow Fruit, Model: Bison. Eaten by Dalton, granting a powerful charging attack and thick, protective hide.
Cow-Cow Fruit, Model: Giraffe. Eaten by Motobaro of the Fire Tank Pirates, granting a towering reach and powerful legs.
lore.mineminenomi.usopps_boots: The boots worn by Usopp, the Straw Hat Pirates' sniper. Practical footwear for a man who prefers to keep his distance from danger.
lore.mineminenomi.usopps_overall: The overalls worn by Usopp. Simple, unassuming attire for a self-proclaimed brave warrior of the sea.
lore.mineminenomi.usopps_pants: The trousers worn by Usopp beneath his overalls. Built for a life of climbing, running, and the occasional heroic retreat.
lore.mineminenomi.vice_admiral_boots: Standard boots worn by a Marine Vice Admiral. Sturdy enough for a lifetime of hunting down dangerous pirates.
lore.mineminenomi.vice_admiral_jacket: The formal jacket worn by a Marine Vice Admiral, marking their high rank within the organization. Its wearer commands considerable authority and combat skill.
lore.mineminenomi.vice_admiral_pants: Part of the uniform worn by a Marine Vice Admiral. Practical attire for an officer who leads from the front.
lore.mineminenomi.vivre_card: A slip of paper containing a fragment of its owner's very soul. It burns slowly over time, and its remaining scrap will always point toward the person it represents.
lore.mineminenomi.wado_ichimonji: A legendary white-sheathed blade that belonged to Kuina, later inherited by her childhood rival Roronoa Zoro.
lore.mineminenomi.walker: A compact pistol favored for its reliability in close-quarters gunfights.
lore.mineminenomi.wandering_dugong_spawn: Spawns a Wandering Dugong, a peaceful aquatic mammal that roams the open seas without a fixed home.
lore.mineminenomi.wanted_poster: A poster displaying a wanted criminal's face, name, and bounty. The higher the reward, the more dangerous the pirate is considered to be.
lore.mineminenomi.wanted_poster_package: A bundle of freshly printed wanted posters, ready to be distributed across the world. News of a new bounty travels fast once these go up.
lore.mineminenomi.wara_wara_no_mi: Straw-Straw Fruit. Eaten by Basil Hawkins, letting him create voodoo-like straw dolls linked to a target, transferring any damage the doll takes directly to them.
lore.mineminenomi.warabide_sword: A sword with a fern-shaped pommel, styled after an ancient design predating the katana. A relic of a much older era of swordsmithing.
lore.mineminenomi.watering_can: A can used to nurture Dandelions grown from a devoted ally's tears. Each watering brings the flower closer to full healing bloom.
lore.mineminenomi.wax_block: A solid block of hardened wax, courtesy of the Doru Doru no Mi. Sturdy enough to build entire structures from, given enough of it.
lore.mineminenomi.white_walkie_coat: A heavy coat worn to endure the bitter cold of a frozen wasteland. Its wearer has adapted to conditions that would kill an ordinary person.
lore.mineminenomi.white_walkie_spawn_egg: Spawns a White Walkie, a humanoid creature adapted to survive in the harshest frozen climates.
lore.mineminenomi.whos_who_mask: The tiger mask worn by Who's Who, a Zoan-type officer of the Big Mom Pirates. He wears it as a badge of the pride he once lost and hopes to reclaim.
lore.mineminenomi.wide_brim_hat: A hat with a wide brim, useful for keeping sun and rain off its wearer's face. A practical choice for a life spent traveling.
lore.mineminenomi.wizard_hat: A tall, pointed hat associated with sorcery and spellcasting. More about the look than any actual magical power.
lore.mineminenomi.wooden_box: A simple wooden chest known to contain a Devil Fruit. The humblest of the three box tiers, but no less likely to hold a life-changing find.
lore.mineminenomi.wootz_steel_armor: Armor forged from Wootz steel, a legendary metal renowned for holding an edge and resisting damage far better than ordinary steel.
lore.mineminenomi.wrestling_dugong_spawn: Spawns a Wrestling Dugong, an aquatic mammal trained in grappling combat. Don't underestimate its ability to pin an opponent.
lore.mineminenomi.yagara_bull_spawn_egg: Spawns a Yagara Bull, a seahorse-like creature used as transportation across the waters of Fishman Island.
lore.mineminenomi.yami_yami_no_mi: Dark-Dark Fruit. Eaten by Marshall D. Teach (Blackbeard), letting him create absolute darkness that pulls in and negates anything it touches, at the cost of being the only Logia user who can still be struck by physical attacks.
lore.mineminenomi.yomi_yomi_no_mi: Revive-Revive Fruit. Eaten by Brook, granting him a second life as a soul returned to his own skeleton, along with his memories and love of music.
lore.mineminenomi.yoru: The pitch-black blade wielded by Dracule Mihawk, the strongest swordsman in the world.
lore.mineminenomi.yuki_yuki_no_mi: Snow-Snow Fruit. Eaten by Monet, letting her generate and control snow, freezing anything struck by it with lingering frostbite.
lore.mineminenomi.zoros_boots: The boots worn by Roronoa Zoro, the Straw Hat Pirates' swordsman. Well-worn from years spent training and fighting his way across the Grand Line.
lore.mineminenomi.zoros_pants: The dark trousers worn by Roronoa Zoro. Simple attire for a man who lets his swords do most of the talking.
lore.mineminenomi.zoros_shirt: The green haramaki-style shirt worn by Roronoa Zoro. A practical, unassuming look for one of the strongest swordsmen alive.
lore.mineminenomi.zou_zou_no_mi: Elephant-Elephant Fruit. Eaten by Funkfreed, the talking sword of the Buggy Pirates, letting him transform into a full elephant.
lore.mineminenomi.zou_zou_no_mi_model_ma: Elephant-Elephant Fruit, Model: Mammoth. Eaten by Jack of the Beasts Pirates, granting the size and strength of a creature long thought extinct.
lore.mineminenomi.zushi_zushi_no_mi: Gravity-Gravity Fruit. Eaten by Issho (Fujitora), letting him manipulate gravity to crush enemies or pull distant objects, including meteors, from the sky.
lore.inofruits.itachi_itachi_no_mi_model: Weasel-Weasel Fruit, Model: Ferret. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into a quick, low-slung ferret or a clawed ferret-hybrid, backed by a bounding leap, tearing claws, and a foul musk spray that saps and slows anyone nearby.
lore.inofruits.hone_hone_no_mi: Bone-Bone Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user - despite the name, this isn't Brook's actual Devil Fruit, the Yomi Yomi no Mi - it lets the eater grow and throw their own bones, wear an outer skeleton for raw power, and knit their bones back together to heal.
lore.inofruits.bone_blade: Grown straight out of a Hone Hone no Mi user's arm rather than carried, it's a blade of living bone that can also burst into a spray of shattering splinters at close range.
lore.inofruits.kobo_kobo_no_mi: Spill Spill no Mi. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, its powers all revolve around forcing things to spill or empty out - items, container contents, even blood or a stomach's contents - without dealing any direct harm.
lore.inofruits.iro_iro_no_mi: Dye-Dye Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it lets the eater throw blinding paint, mark a target so it shows through walls, camouflage against a background while standing still, and pick a dye colour that grants a different combat bonus.
lore.inofruits.shio_shio_no_mi: Salt-Salt Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it lets the eater raise spikes of hardened salt from the ground, salt enemies so their wounds stop healing, and turn into a current of salt that sears the undead and purifies allies.
lore.inofruits.wani_wani_no_mi_model_cro: Crocodile-Crocodile Fruit, Model: Crocodile. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into an armoured crocodile that's slow on land but fast in water, built around a jaw-locking death roll and a sweeping tail attack.
lore.inofruits.bai_bai_no_mi: Multiplication Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it splits the eater into three fighting copies of themselves for half a minute and can permanently duplicate a held item, though it refuses to copy Devil Fruits, currency, or anything bound to a person.
lore.inofruits.nezu_nezu_no_mi_model_rat: Rat-Rat Fruit, Model: Rat. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into a rat or rat-hybrid that fits through tight gaps, sees in the dark, gnaws straight through solid blocks, and bites a spreading plague into its prey.
lore.inofruits.chiku_chiku_no_mi: Accumulation fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it banks a portion of every blow the eater takes as stored force, then releases it either as a single powerful bolt or as an omnidirectional blast that catches the user in it too.
lore.inofruits.ichi_ichi_no_mi: Swapping fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it lets the eater instantly trade places with whatever they're looking at, and extends to swapping held items, dragging a target close, or exchanging everyone within range at once.
lore.inofruits.tsuchi_tsuchi_no_mi: Earth-Earth Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it lets the eater cloak themselves in a hulking golem of packed earth, throw up walls and ridges of stone, hurl boulders, and swallow enemies into the ground up to their shoulders.
lore.inofruits.fukuro_fukuro_no_mi_model: Owl-Owl Fruit, Model: Owl. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into an owl or owl-hybrid built for flight, with a wing-beat that throws enemies clear, silent night vision, and talons that can snatch up a target mid-flight.
lore.inofruits.kujira_kujira_no_mi_model: Whale-Whale Fruit, Model: Whale. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into a whale or whale-hybrid, nearly impossible to hurt and fast in water despite its size, and lets them slam down from above to crush and scatter everything nearby.
lore.inofruits.tsuri_tsuri_no_mi: Fishing-Fishing Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it lets the eater hook and reel in distant targets or items, yank themselves toward anything in sight with a grappling line, and pull in double the usual catch whenever they fish.
lore.inofruits.yuge_yuge_no_mi: Steam-Steam Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it lets the eater turn into scalding steam, soak enemies so their Devil Fruit powers stop working, and finish them with a jet or blast of steam that hits far harder against a target already soaked.
lore.inofruits.kaze_kaze_no_mi: Wind-Wind Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, built around commanding gusts and currents of air.
lore.inofruits.suji_suji_no_mi: Muscle-Muscle Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, built around controlling muscle and sinew, the eater's own or someone else's.
lore.inofruits.wata_wata_no_mi: Cotton-Cotton Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, built around generating and shaping soft, smothering cotton.
lore.inofruits.gamu_gamu_no_mi: Gum-Gum Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user - a play on chewing gum, not to be confused with Luffy's rubber-granting Gomu Gomu no Mi - built around sticky, stretching gum.
lore.inofruits.mitsu_mitsu_no_mi: Honey-Honey Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, built around generating thick, trapping honey.
lore.inofruits.neji_neji_no_mi: twist-twist Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, built around twisting and boring through whatever it's turned on.
lore.inofruits.kero_kero_no_mi: Frog-Frog Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into a frog or frog-hybrid built for leaping and sticking to surfaces.
lore.inofruits.ita_ita_no_mi_model_ferre: An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into a ferret or ferret-hybrid.
lore.inofruits.zuku_zuku_no_mi_model_owl: Zuku is an old regional Japanese word for owl. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into an owl or owl-hybrid built for flight.
lore.inofruits.mushi_mushi_no_mi_model_m: Bug-Bug Fruit, Model: Mosquito. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into a mosquito or mosquito-hybrid built around biting and draining prey.
lore.inofruits.isa_isa_no_mi_model_whale: Isa echoes the old poetic Japanese word for whale, isana. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into a whale or whale-hybrid.
lore.inofruits.kani_kani_no_mi_model_cra: Crab-Crab Fruit, Model: Crab. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into a crab or crab-hybrid built for crushing claws and a hard shell.
lore.inofruits.usa_usa_no_mi_model_hare: Hare-Hare Fruit, Model: Hare. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into a hare or hare-hybrid built for speed.
lore.inofruits.fugu_fugu_no_mi_model_puf: Pufferfish-Pufferfish Fruit, Model: Pufferfish. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, turning the eater into a pufferfish or pufferfish-hybrid built around toxic spines and a defensive puffed-up state.
lore.inofruits.kiza_kiza_no_mi: The gauge Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it marks a target with a hidden slider that can be pulled down to strip something from them and hand it to the eater, or pulled back on the eater's own slider to clear every bad effect on them at once.
lore.inofruits.kane_kane_no_mi: Treasure-Treasure Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it senses wealth around the eater - highlighting ore through walls, marking the single most valuable thing nearby, and revealing a container's contents without opening it - and makes them luckier besides.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_ingot: Fused inside its wielder's own body out of obsidian, diamond, gold and iron by the Bakumetal Genesis ability, it's the raw material behind a whole set of near-indestructible gear.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_sword: Forged from Bakumetal, it hits harder and shrugs off blows better the more Bakumetal gear its wielder carries, and pairing it with a full Bakumetal suit cuts down the knockback they take.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_pickaxe: A mining tool forged from Bakumetal - the more of the set its holder wears or carries, the harder they hit and the better they shrug off blows.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_axe: Forged from Bakumetal, it hits harder and takes hits better the more Bakumetal gear its wielder has on.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_shovel: A digging tool forged from Bakumetal, part of a set that makes its wearer hit harder and take hits better the more of it they carry.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_hoe: A farming tool forged from Bakumetal, part of a set that makes its wearer hit harder and take hits better the more of it they carry.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_helmet: Smithed from Bakumetal, wearing it alongside more of the set makes its owner hit harder and take blows better.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_chestpla: Smithed from Bakumetal, wearing it alongside more of the set makes its owner hit harder and take blows better.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_leggings: Smithed from Bakumetal, wearing it alongside more of the set makes its owner hit harder and take blows better.
lore.awakenawakennomi.bakumetal_boots: Smithed from Bakumetal, wearing it alongside more of the set makes its owner hit harder and take blows better - a full suit with a Bakumetal weapon cuts the wearer's knockback down further.
lore.awakenawakennomi.candy: What's left behind when an awakened Pero Pero no Mi user's Candy Transmutation finishes turning a target solid - the same candy-manipulating power Charlotte Perospero wields in canon.
lore.fightingstyles.dial_bag: A padded satchel built to carry Skypiea's fragile Dial spheres without cracking them open or setting one off by accident.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_flame_dial: A rare, potent cut of a Flame Dial - the same fire-storing Skypiean sphere used across the Sky Islands - strong enough to grant a Fruitless user full command of fire on its own.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_axe_dial: Loaded with a stored blade of compressed air, it fires a single cut sharp enough to shear through armor.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_impact_dial: Works like the Impact Dials Skypieans use to bank the force of a blow and unleash it later, letting its holder charge their fists with stored impact energy.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_flash_dial: Holds a stored burst of pure light, the same principle behind Skypiea's blinding Flash Dials, ready to be released in one dazzling burst.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_breath_dial: Packed with compressed air like the Breath Dials Skypieans use to launch themselves and their weapons, giving its holder a sudden burst of directed wind.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_eisen_dial: An Iron Dial in the Skypiean tradition, hardening the clouds of Skypiea into solid, iron-grey plating for a makeshift shield.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_milky_dial: Treated with the same process Skypieans use to pave roads across the White-White Sea, it lays down a solid path of cloud that can be walked or surfed across open air.
lore.fightingstyles.golden_reject_dial: True to the Skypiean original, it doesn't generate anything of its own - it simply throws back whatever force is thrown at it.
lore.fightingstyles.shipwright_marker: Placed in a linked pair to bookmark a build's corners, so a Shipwright can save the structure between them and rebuild it exactly later.
lore.fightingstyles.upgraded_oak_boat: An ordinary oak boat reinforced by a Shipwright's own hands, cutting through open water noticeably faster than the stock hull.
lore.fightingstyles.upgraded_spruce_boat: An ordinary spruce boat reinforced by a Shipwright's own hands, cutting through open water noticeably faster than the stock hull.
lore.fightingstyles.upgraded_birch_boat: An ordinary birch boat reinforced by a Shipwright's own hands, cutting through open water noticeably faster than the stock hull.
lore.fightingstyles.upgraded_jungle_boat: An ordinary jungle wood boat reinforced by a Shipwright's own hands, cutting through open water noticeably faster than the stock hull.
lore.fightingstyles.upgraded_acacia_boat: An ordinary acacia boat reinforced by a Shipwright's own hands, cutting through open water noticeably faster than the stock hull.
lore.fightingstyles.upgraded_dark_oak_bo: An ordinary dark oak boat reinforced by a Shipwright's own hands, cutting through open water noticeably faster than the stock hull.
lore.fightingstyles.kogetsu_trigger: Standard-issue Border blade, most iconically wielded by ace attacker Kei Tachikawa - a straightforward energy sword built for disciplined, direct exchanges.
lore.fightingstyles.scorpion_trigger: Devised specifically to give Yuma Kuga a blade of his own to match Tachikawa's Kogetsu, it grows flexible, shape-shifting edges suited to sudden lunges and close-range reshaping.
lore.fightingstyles.raygust_trigger: Osamu Mikumo's signature Trigger - a shapeshifting hybrid that's weak on offense but tough to break, able to switch between a broad guard wall and a crushing blade.
lore.fightingstyles.asteroid_trigger: Border's standard-issue gunner Trigger, firing dependable Trion bullet volleys with no special properties of its own beyond raw reliability.
lore.fightingstyles.hound_trigger: A guided gunner Trigger whose bullets curve in flight to chase down a locked target.
lore.fightingstyles.meteor_trigger: An explosive gunner Trigger built for arcing bombardment, trading precision for splash damage against clustered targets.
lore.fightingstyles.viper_trigger: A programmable gunner Trigger whose shots can be steered along a set route before folding back onto the target.
lore.fightingstyles.gimlet_trigger: An Asteroid-based composite that compresses its bullets into dense, armor-piercing drill shots.
