lore.fightingstyles.hornet_trigger: A Hound-based composite that splits its homing shots into a tighter, delayed-pursuit swarm.
lore.fightingstyles.tomahawk_trigger: A Meteor-Hound composite that guides an explosive shell onto a target before detonating it.
lore.fightingstyles.salamander_trigger: A Meteor-Viper composite that bends explosive shells around cover before the blast lands.
lore.fightingstyles.cobra_trigger: An Asteroid-Viper composite tuned for sharper, harder-angled curving shots.
lore.fightingstyles.egret_trigger: Border's standard long-range sniper beam Trigger, built for steady, disciplined shots at extreme distance.
lore.fightingstyles.ibis_trigger: A heavy anti-materiel sniper Trigger, firing a beam powerful enough to punch clean through multiple lined-up targets.
lore.fightingstyles.lightning_trigger: A fast, lighter sniper Trigger built for quick snapshots and repeated pressure rather than a single heavy blow.
lore.fightingstyles.shield_trigger: Border's standard defensive barrier Trigger, a flexible wall of hexagonal panels that can track a threat, lock in place, or close into a full ring around its user.
lore.fightingstyles.escudo_trigger: A sudden barricade Trigger that flares out to block a lane and shove enemies back on contact.
lore.fightingstyles.radar_trigger: An Optional Trigger that performs a holographic sweep of the area, lighting up nearby hostile Trion signatures.
lore.fightingstyles.chameleon_trigger: An Optional Trigger that bends light around its user for a short burst of concealment while moving fast.
lore.fightingstyles.bagworm_trigger: An Optional stealth Trigger that trades speed for a much longer-lasting cloak.
lore.fightingstyles.grasshopper_trigger: An Optional mobility Trigger that lays down an elastic pad to launch its user through the air.
lore.fightingstyles.teleporter_trigger: A short-range warp Trigger, moving its user instantly along their own line of sight.
lore.fightingstyles.geist_trigger: A prototype overload Trigger that trades stability for a sharp boost to combat power.
lore.fightingstyles.full_arms_trigger: A prototype Trigger that floods the user's Trion body with raw offensive output at heavy upkeep.
lore.fightingstyles.idaten_trigger: A mobility-focused prototype Trigger built for explosive bursts of acceleration and pursuit.
lore.fightingstyles.fujin_black_trigger: Shuji Miwa's Black Trigger, cutting down enemies with invisible, line-of-sight blades of compressed wind - the technique that turned the tide against Yuichi Jin in the very first Black Trigger clash Border witnessed.
lore.fightingstyles.yuma_black_trigger: Not a weapon Yuma carries but the Black Trigger body he was built as, letting him copy and layer other agents' seals - Bound, Boost, Chain, Anchor, Shield, Bolt - into his own fast-repairing frame.
lore.fightingstyles.organon_black_trigge: One of Aftokrator's national-treasure Black Triggers, tied to their agent Viza - a cane concealing blades fast and powerful enough to level a city block in an instant.
lore.fightingstyles.amo_black_trigger: A little-documented Aftokrator Black Trigger, capable of saturating a wide area with overlapping blasts.
lore.fightingstyles.alektor_black_trigge: One of Aftokrator's national-treasure Black Triggers, built to immobilize and restrain whatever it catches.
lore.fightingstyles.speiraskia_black_tri: One of Aftokrator's national-treasure Black Triggers, folding space to move its user instantly across the battlefield.
lore.fightingstyles.borboros_black_trigg: Closer to canon's Vorvoros in spelling, one of Aftokrator's national-treasure Black Triggers, a corrosive, toxic form built to endure punishment as much as deal it.
lore.inofruits.kero_kero_no_mi_model_fro: Frog-Frog Fruit, Model: Frog. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into a frog or frog-hybrid built for jumping, with a tongue that can grab and reel in a target, slam down from above, and skin sticky enough to catch an incoming projectile.
lore.inofruits.kuma_kuma_no_mi_model_gri: Bear-Bear Fruit, Model: Grizzly. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into a grizzly bear or bear-hybrid built for brawling, hitting harder the more hurt they are and shrugging off blows, knockback and cold through its thick fur.
lore.inofruits.chi_chi_no_mi: Blood-Blood Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, every technique costs the eater's own blood, which banks in a reserve gauge and pays before their health does, while pulling blood back out of bleeding enemies heals them for double.
lore.inofruits.oki_oki_no_mi: Law-Law Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it lets the eater proclaim one of sixteen laws - from freezing all movement to nullifying every Devil Fruit power - that binds everyone in a zone around them, themselves included.
lore.inofruits.kugi_kugi_no_mi: Nail-Nail Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it drives nails that root a target in place, bristles from the eater's own body to punish anyone who touches them, and rips every nail out at once for damage that scales with how many were driven in.
lore.inofruits.kutsu_kutsu_no_mi: Shoe-Shoe Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it grants six interchangeable soles - walking on water and lava, climbing any surface, moving without a sound, standing immovable, jumping seven blocks high, or skating at speed - one worn at a time.
lore.inofruits.uma_uma_no_mi_model_unico: Horse-Horse Fruit, Model: Unicorn. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, it turns the eater into a flying unicorn or unicorn-hybrid whose horn both strikes through armour and intangibility and channels a healing light that burns away harmful effects on the eater and their allies.

lore.inocruise.ice_stag_beetle_spawn_egg: Spawns an Ice Miyama Stag Beetle.
lore.inocruise.flying_penguin: A Flying Penguin, netted over the frozen sea.
lore.inocruise.a_class_toad: An A Class Toad, the hardiest amphibian of all.
lore.inocruise.lotus_seed: A seed harvested from the water's edge.
lore.inocruise.sea_king_scale: A scale from a Sea King, worth a small fortune.
lore.inocruise.sea_king_fin: A fin from a Sea King, a trophy for whoever survived the fight.
lore.inocruise.sea_king_head_crest: The head crest of a Sea King, the finest trophy of the hunt.
lore.inocruise.delicacy_assortment: A dish cooked from a Sea King's body at a Kitchen.
lore.inocruise.meat_lovers_delight: A dish cooked from a Sea King's body at a Kitchen.
lore.inocruise.roasted_meat_festival: A dish cooked from a Sea King's body at a Kitchen.
lore.inocruise.medicine: The last of the Chemist's brews, compounded at a Laboratory.
lore.inocruise.experiment_equipment: Carry it and a Chemist's brews have a better chance of yielding one extra.
lore.inocruise.enhanced_bombs: Bombs that burst where they land.
lore.inocruise.blind_spot_cannonball: Thirty Enhanced Bombs packed into one cannonball. A heavier blast, and its smoke leaves you blind.
lore.inocruise.rubber_fruit: Picked from a Rubber Fruit tree.
lore.inocruise.pure_iron_ore: A purer iron ore used by Inventors.
lore.inocruise.tone_dial: Press it on a note block to keep the note, or in the air to play it back.
lore.inocruise.auction_house: One market for the whole server. List goods, buy other players' lots and collect your earnings.
lore.inocruise.kitchen: The Cook's workstation, where the islands' dishes are made in three qualities.
lore.inocruise.workshop: The Inventor's workstation. Reels, sieves, nets, traps, dials and more are built here.
lore.inocruise.laboratory: The Chemist's workstation, for compounding remedies, powders and battle balls.
lore.inocruise.upgrade_bench: Put a tool in one slot and a part in the other and take the fitted tool from the third. The tool keeps its wear and enchantments.
lore.inocruise.traps: A Hunter's traps. Set them down to catch creatures.
lore.inocruise.enhanced_traps: Sturdier traps from an Inventor. They keep their parts once set down.
lore.inocruise.tannery: The Hunter's workstation, for working leather.
lore.inocruise.firefly_lantern: A lantern that gives off a soft firefly glow.
lore.inocruise.ships_locker: A single storage locker that does not pair. It keeps what is in it when broken.
lore.inocruise.reinforced_locker: A bigger locker that does not pair. It keeps what is in it when broken.
lore.inocruise.kuuigosu_locker: A locker of Kuuigosu wood that does not pair. It keeps what is in it when broken.
lore.inocruise.adam_strongbox: A strongbox of Adam Wood that does not pair. It keeps what is in it when broken.
lore.inocruise.specimen_case: A case for displaying a creature you have caught.
lore.inocruise.masonry: The Miner's workstation, for cutting stone and marble.
lore.inocruise.polished_marble: Polished marble, cut at the Masonry.
lore.inocruise.polished_marble_slab: A polished marble slab, cut at the Masonry.
lore.inocruise.explosive_rock: A volatile rock. Break it into fragments carefully and it will not go off.
lore.inocruise.shipyard: The Carpenter's workstation, where hulls, boats, lockers and hull parts are built.
lore.inocruise.forge: The Blacksmith's workstation, where the base mod's weapons are forged.
lore.inocruise.sewing_table: The Tailor's workstation, where hats, capes, masks and outfits are sewn.
lore.inocruise.chart_table: The Navigator's workstation, for Log Poses, Barometers and Sea Charts.
lore.inocruise.music_stand: The Musician's workstation, where scores are written.
lore.inocruise.grand_piano: A grand piano, 2 x 4 blocks with its stool. Sit at it and play a score.
lore.inocruise.fine_grand_piano: A finer grand piano, 2 x 4 blocks with its stool. Sit at it and play a score.
lore.inocruise.masters_grand_piano: A master's grand piano, 2 x 4 blocks with its stool. Sit at it and play a score.
lore.inocruise.red_fruit_sapling: Only a Farmer can plant it. It grows into a Red Fruit tree.
lore.inocruise.blue_fruit_sapling: Only a Farmer can plant it. It grows into a Blue Fruit tree.
lore.inocruise.brown_fruit_sapling: Only a Farmer can plant it. It grows into a Brown Fruit tree.
lore.inocruise.horrific_pear_sapling: Only a Farmer can plant it. It grows into a Horrific Pear tree.
lore.inocruise.golden_fruit_sapling: Only a Farmer can plant it. It grows into a Golden Fruit tree.
lore.inocruise.palm_sapling: Only a Farmer can plant it. It grows into a palm.
lore.inocruise.rubber_fruit_sapling: Only a Farmer can plant it. It grows into a Rubber Fruit tree.
lore.inocruise.adam_sapling: A sapling of the colossal Treasure Tree Adam, which only a high-level Lumberjack can fell.
lore.inocruise.burning_tree_sapling: A sapling of the Burning Tree from the story.
lore.inocruise.kuuigosu_sapling: A sapling of the Kuuigosu tree from the story.
lore.inomissing.kama_kama_no_mi: Sickle-Sickle Fruit. Eaten by Eric in the One Piece anime, letting him grow his nails into sickles and fire air blades, up to a whirlwind-topped volley.
lore.inomissing.choki_choki_no_mi: Snip-Snip Fruit. Eaten by Inazuma, letting him turn his hands into giant scissors that cut enemies, blocks and even the ground like paper.
lore.inomissing.ami_ami_no_mi: Net-Net Fruit. Eaten by Largo in the One Piece anime, letting him throw sticky, barbed, burning and boiling nets that hold targets, and turn his body into a net that softens hits.
lore.inomissing.inu_inu_no_mi_model_wolf: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Wolf. Eaten by Jabra of CP9, letting him become a fast wolf or a clawed wolf-man hybrid with Rankyaku and Tekkai techniques, stronger at night.
lore.inomissing.tori_tori_no_mi_model_fa: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Falcon. Eaten by Pell, letting him become a falcon hybrid or a giant falcon that flies fast, dives on foes and carries another player.
lore.inomissing.gasha_gasha_no_mi: Gasha Gasha no Mi. Eaten by Douglas Bullet in the film One Piece: Stampede, letting him build arm cannons, turrets, scrap soldiers and a giant mech from scrap.
lore.inomissing.fuwa_fuwa_no_mi: Float-Float Fruit. Eaten by Shiki the Golden Lion, letting him spin blocks around him, shape the ground into lion heads and fly weightlessly.
lore.inomissing.mori_mori_no_mi: Forest-Forest Fruit. Eaten by Admiral Aramaki (Greenbull), turning the user into living wood that can become a tree golem, drain enemies with roots and sprout a flower to fly. Fire hurts the user extra.
lore.inomissing.numa_numa_no_mi: Swamp-Swamp Fruit. Eaten by Caribou, turning the user into swamp that traps enemies in mud and stores absorbed arrows to fire from a Gatling gun.
lore.inomissing.ton_ton_no_mi: Ton-Ton Fruit. Eaten by Machvise of the Donquixote Pirates, letting him become many tonnes heavy for crushing stomps, tackles and Vise drops.
lore.inomissing.nui_nui_no_mi: Stitch-Stitch Fruit. Eaten by Leo of the Tontatta Kingdom, letting him sew enemies to the ground, to each other or to a block, and stitch up wounds.
lore.inomissing.pamu_pamu_no_mi: Pop-Pop Fruit. Eaten by Gladius of the Donquixote Pirates, letting him inflate the ground, bullets and his own body until they explode.
lore.inomissing.ato_ato_no_mi: Art-Art Fruit. Eaten by Giolla of the Donquixote Pirates, turning enemies, projectiles and terrain into harmless art, and even flattening foes into paintings.
lore.inomissing.hira_hira_no_mi: Flag-Flag Fruit. Eaten by Diamante, letting him stretch his sword like a whip, turn his cape into a steel shield and flatten his body to glide down.
lore.inomissing.hobi_hobi_no_mi: Hobby-Hobby Fruit. Eaten by Sugar of the Donquixote Pirates, turning those she punches into toys that she can put under contract to fight for her.
lore.inomissing.buki_buki_no_mi: Arms-Arms Fruit. Eaten by Baby 5 of the Donquixote Pirates, letting her turn her body into swords, revolvers, flamethrowers and missiles.
lore.inomissing.guru_guru_no_mi: Spin-Spin Fruit. Eaten by Buffalo of the Donquixote Pirates, turning his head, arms and legs into propellers for flight, gusts of wind and spinning attacks.
lore.inomissing.mushi_mushi_no_mi_model_: Bug-Bug Fruit, Model: Rhinoceros Beetle. Eaten by Kabu of the Tontatta Kingdom, letting him become a four-armed, horned beetle that flies and charges through enemies.
Bug-Bug Fruit, Model: Hornet. Eaten by Bian of the Tontatta Kingdom, letting her become a hornet with wings and a poisonous stinger, and summon Pink Hornets.
lore.inomissing.ishi_ishi_no_mi: Stone-Stone Fruit. Eaten by Pica of the Donquixote Pirates, letting him merge with stone and raise stone tentacles, spikes, fists and giant stone bodies.
lore.inomissing.giro_giro_no_mi: Glare-Glare Fruit. Eaten by Princess Viola of Dressrosa, letting her see through walls, read enemies' minds and see great distances.
lore.akuma.noble_box: A lavish box reserved for World Nobles, holding a Devil Fruit.
lore.akuma.yakuza_kasen: Admiral Fujitora's cane sword, a Supreme Grade blade forged by the Wano swordsmith Fugetsu Kisaburo and kept hidden inside a walking stick.
lore.akuma.shodai_kitetsu: The first and deadliest of the cursed Kitetsu blades, a Supreme Grade sword wielded by Saint Nusjuro of the Gorosei.
lore.akuma.glaive_of_god: A glaive conjured by an Akuma no Mi user, withering anything it cuts.
lore.akuma.gram: Named for the Norse blade Sigurd used to slay the dragon Fafnir.
lore.akuma.fragarach: Named for the "Answerer" of Irish myth, a sword that no armour could stop.
lore.akuma.spear_of_longinus: Named for the lance said to have pierced Christ's side, carried by the Roman soldier Longinus.
lore.akuma.honebami_toshiro: Named for a real Japanese sword of legend, whose name means "bone-gnawer".
lore.akuma.royal_guard_helmet: Part of the armor worn by the Royal Guard, the personal guards of the Celestial Dragons.
lore.akuma.royal_guard_chestplate: Part of the armor worn by the Royal Guard, the personal guards of the Celestial Dragons.
lore.akuma.royal_guard_leggings: Part of the armor worn by the Royal Guard, the personal guards of the Celestial Dragons.
lore.akuma.royal_guard_boots: Part of the armor worn by the Royal Guard, the personal guards of the Celestial Dragons.
lore.akuma.cipher_pol_recruitment_office: Spawns a Cipher Pol Recruitment Officer, an NPC who offers quests, buys Devil Fruit boxes, and lets qualified players join the World Government.
lore.akuma.cipher_pol_agent_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cipher Pol Agent, a World Government operative trained for covert work and close combat.
lore.akuma.cipher_pol_sniper_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cipher Pol Sniper, a World Government operative who strikes from a distance.
lore.akuma.cipher_pol_0_agent_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cipher Pol 0 Agent, an elite operative of Cipher Pol Aegis 0, the World Government's most secretive branch.
lore.akuma.notorious_cipher_pol_0_agent_: Spawns a Notorious Cipher Pol Aegis 0 Agent, a far more dangerous operative than the rank and file.
lore.akuma.royal_guard_spawn_egg: Spawns a Royal Guard, an armored guardian of the Celestial Dragons.
lore.akuma.akuma_no_mi: Demon Fruit. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, despite sharing its name with the Japanese word for every Devil Fruit. It turns the eater into a devil who binds others into tiered pacts and calls down omens, and only Busoshoku Internal Destruction or Haoshoku Infusion can wound them.
lore.akuma.uma_uma_no_mi_model_bakotsu: Horse-Horse Fruit, Model: Bakotsu. An original model of the canon Horse-Horse Fruit, whose canon eater is Gan Fall's bird Pierre. It turns the eater into a nightmarish spectral horse that bites and trails frostbite, trampling anything in its path.
lore.akuma.kumo_kumo_no_mi_model_gyuki: Spider-Spider Fruit, Model: Gyuki. An original model of the canon Spider-Spider Fruit, whose canon eater is Black Maria of the Beasts Pirates. It turns the eater into a gyuki, a spider-bodied demon with a bull's head, armed with sharp legs, poison pellets and a stunning glare.
lore.akuma.buta_buta_no_mi_model_feng_xi: Pig-Pig Fruit, Model: Feng Xi. An original fruit for this addon with no canon One Piece user, named for the giant boar of Chinese myth. It turns the eater into a tusked brute that roars, rams with its skull, and turns its tusks into blades.
lore.akuma.mushi_mushi_no_mi_model_sand_: Bug-Bug Fruit, Model: Sand Wyrm. An original model of the canon Bug-Bug Fruit, whose canon eaters include Kabu. It turns the eater into a burrowing wyrm that tunnels through the ground, drills down from above, and swallows targets whole.
lore.akuma.tori_tori_no_mi_model_itsumad: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Itsumade. An original model of the canon Bird-Bird Fruit, whose canon eaters include Marco. It turns the eater into the fire-breathing bird of Japanese folklore, with explosive flame beams, crushing talons, and tornadoes that hunt down targets.
lore.inomissing.pasa_pasa_no_mi: Paper-Paper Fruit. Eaten by Simon, the villain of the non-canon game Great Hidden Treasure of the Nanatsu Islands, letting him become a swarm of paper sheets that fly and cut, bind and wall off enemies.
lore.inomissing.ame_ame_no_mi: Syrup-Syrup Fruit. Eaten by Gasparde in the non-canon film Dead End Adventure, turning his body into green candy syrup that holds whoever hits it and hardens into spears and spikes.
lore.inomissing.toro_toro_no_mi: Liquid-Liquid Fruit. Eaten by Honey Queen in the non-canon film Clockwork Island Adventure, turning her body into liquid that flows through gaps as a pool and strikes with waves, geysers and drowning spheres.
lore.inomissing.goru_goru_no_mi: Gold-Gold Fruit. Eaten by Gild Tesoro, the villain of Film: Gold, letting him move gold at will to make statues, lances and a giant golden golem.
lore.inomissing.toki_toki_no_mi: Time-Time Fruit. Eaten by Kozuki Toki, sending the user, an ally, an enemy or incoming shots forward in time so they vanish and return to the same place later.
lore.inomissing.uta_uta_no_mi: Song-Song Fruit. Eaten by Uta in Film: Red, carrying everyone who hears her song into Uta World, a dream concert stage where the singer flies and fights.
lore.inomissing.atsu_atsu_no_mi: Hot-Hot Fruit. Eaten by Don Accino in the anime-only Ice Hunter arc, raising the user's body heat up to 10,000 degrees to throw balls of heat, seize enemies in steam and melt ice and snow.
lore.inomissing.fude_fude_no_mi: Brush-Brush Fruit. Eaten by Kurozumi Kanjuro, making whatever the user draws in ink come to life, from sparrows and a dragon to snakes, weapons and food.
lore.inomissing.gutsu_gutsu_no_mi: Eaten by Bill in the anime-only Silver Mine arc, turning the user's body into a furnace that eats metal, forges weapons for the crew and spits molten metal.
lore.inomissing.kote_kote_no_mi: Gauntlet-Gauntlet Fruit. Eaten by Adio in One Piece Odyssey, summoning great gauntlets of light that punch, grab, lift and crush, and raising lightning barriers that turn shots back.
lore.inomissing.moa_moa_no_mi: Eaten by Byrnndi World in 3D2Y, multiplying the size or speed of things up to a hundred times, so pebbles fly like cannonballs and the user moves in bursts of speed.
lore.inomissing.modo_modo_no_mi: Return-Return Fruit. Eaten by Ain in Film: Z, sending what it touches twelve years back, so bodies shrink and weaken, stone turns back to lava and worn items are made new again.
lore.inomissing.noko_noko_no_mi: Mushroom-Mushroom Fruit. Eaten by Musshuru in Episode of Chopper Plus, letting him fire poisonous spores that poison and stiffen enemies and grow into fungi.
lore.inomissing.peto_peto_no_mi: Eaten by Breed in the anime-only Caesar Retrieval arc, fitting jelly collars on creatures and players so that they obey the user.
lore.inomissing.fuku_fuku_no_mi: Clothes-Clothes Fruit. Eaten by Kin'emon, turning a leaf or a stone into a full outfit of real armour, for the user or for an ally.
lore.inomissing.juku_juku_no_mi: Ripe-Ripe Fruit. Eaten by Shinobu, letting her ripen or rot whatever she touches, so blocks crumble, gear wears out and the living grow old.
lore.inomissing.kibi_kibi_no_mi: Eaten by Tama, letting her pull dango from her cheek that tame any animal that eats one.
lore.inomissing.koro_koro_no_mi: Eaten by Peseta in the anime-only Silver Mine arc, turning the user's hands and feet into train wheels that roll fast, ride rails, ram and throw explosives.
lore.inomissing.kyubu_kyubu_no_mi: Cube-Cube Fruit. Eaten by Gairam in 3D2Y, cutting blocks into cubes that can be thrown, built into walls or used to shut an enemy inside.
lore.inomissing.maki_maki_no_mi: Scroll-Scroll Fruit. Eaten by Raizo of the Nine Red Scabbards, using scrolls that catch attacks and give them back, store items and make clones.
lore.inomissing.mane_mane_no_mi: Clone-Clone Fruit. Eaten by Bentham (Mr. 2 Bon Clay), letting him take the look of anyone he has touched and keep a memory of their faces.
lore.inomissing.mosa_mosa_no_mi: Eaten by Binz in Film: Z, making the plants around the user grow and obey as thorn whips, holding vines, walls and a plant that devours.
lore.inomissing.nuke_nuke_no_mi: Eaten by Tanaka in Film: Gold, letting the user pass through walls and floors, take an ally along, let shots go through them and open a pit under enemies.
lore.inomissing.tori_tori_no_mi_model_ea: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Eagle. Eaten by Buzz in the 3D short Straw Hat Chase, granting a heavier, tougher bird than the falcon, built to carry off prey and turn shots back with its wings.
lore.inomissing.inu_inu_no_mi_model_tanu: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Tanuki. 'Eaten' by Bunbuku, the teapot of Wano, granting a round brawler form and a small animal form that can burrow and play dead.
lore.inomissing.kumo_kumo_no_mi_model_ro: Spider-Spider Fruit, Model: Rosamygale Grauvogeli. Eaten by Black Maria of the Beasts Pirates, granting a giant ancient spider that climbs walls, lays webs and poisons with its bite.
lore.inomissing.neko_neko_no_mi_model_sa: Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Saber Tiger. Eaten by Who's Who of the Big Mom Pirates, granting an ambush hunter that pounces and holds its prey by the throat.
lore.inomissing.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_pach: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Pachycephalosaurus. Eaten by Ulti of the Beasts Pirates, granting a fast headbutter whose skull breaks walls, pins targets down and falls like a meteor.
lore.inomissing.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_spin: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Spinosaurus. Eaten by Page One of the Beasts Pirates, granting a predator that does not let go, with claws that make enemies bleed and a jaw that crushes.
lore.inomissing.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_tric: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Triceratops. Eaten by Sasaki of the Beasts Pirates, granting a heavily armoured form whose frill spins to fly and whose horns charge and lift.
lore.inomissing.batto_batto_no_mi_model_: Bat-Bat Fruit, Model: Vampire. Eaten by Patrick Redfield in Unlimited World Red, granting a winged vampire and a giant bat form that drain youth with their bite and grow stronger at night.
lore.inomissing.hebi_hebi_no_mi_model_ya: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi. Eaten by Kurozumi Orochi, the shogun of Wano, granting eight heads and eight lives, with the user returning each time a head is lost.
lore.inomissing.hito_hito_no_mi_model_on: Human-Human Fruit, Model: Onyudo. Eaten by Onimaru, granting the giant warrior monk of legend, with a long reach, wide sweeps, a stomp and a gaze that frightens.
lore.inomissing.mira_mira_no_mi: Mirror-Mirror Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Brulee of the Big Mom Pirates, letting her lay mirrors that open into Mirro-World, copy the look of anyone she sees and send hits back with Reflection.
lore.inomissing.kuri_kuri_no_mi: Cream-Cream Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Opera of the Big Mom Pirates, letting him conjure whipped cream, throw it as balls and wrap himself in a protective cream shell.
lore.inomissing.bata_bata_no_mi: Butter-Butter Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Galette of the Big Mom Pirates, letting her wrap or cuff enemies in butter and spread slippery sheets that make everyone but her slide.
lore.inomissing.buku_buku_no_mi: Book-Book Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Mont-d'Or of the Big Mom Pirates, letting her throw books and razor pages, fly on a Flying Book and shut weakened creatures inside prison books.
lore.inomissing.bisu_bisu_no_mi: Biscuit-Biscuit Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Cracker of the Big Mom Pirates, letting him wear a giant biscuit armour, raise biscuit soldiers and walls, and shape the sword Pretzel. Water and rain soften all of it.
lore.inomissing.hoya_hoya_no_mi: Hoya Hoya no Mi. Eaten by Charlotte Daifuku of the Big Mom Pirates, letting him rub his belly to summon a halberd-wielding genie that fights for him. The user walks slowly and can't attack while the genie is out.
lore.inomissing.tama_tama_no_mi: Egg-Egg Fruit. Eaten by Tamago, turning the user into an egg with three lives. Each fatal blow hatches them anew, first as a fast chick, then as a strong rooster.
lore.inomissing.tori_tori_no_mi_model_al: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Albatross. Eaten by Morgans, president of the World Economy News Paper, letting the user become an albatross hybrid or a great albatross that flies for a very long time and carries another player.
lore.inomissing.memo_memo_no_mi: Memory-Memory Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Pudding of the Big Mom Pirates, letting her cut quarrels and abilities out of a creature's memories with shears. She can also paste in false memories that make it fight for her.
lore.inomissing.gocha_gocha_no_mi: Gocha Gocha no Mi. Eaten by Charlotte Newshi of the Big Mom Pirates, letting him merge with allies and his own creatures into one giant whose health and strength add up. The giant swings every member's weapon as a single Great Weapon.
lore.inomissing.mochi_mochi_no_mi: Mochi-Mochi Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Katakuri of the Big Mom Pirates, letting him stretch, harden and stick mochi into punches, a Gatling arm and sticky walls. Awakened, it raises rings of Muso Donuts that throw giant arms.
lore.inomissing.forged_blade: A blade pulled glowing from the body of a Gutsu Gutsu no Mi user, like Bill in the Silver Mine arc, and forged from the best metal in the furnace. It sets what it strikes on fire and melts after 90 seconds or when dropped.
lore.inomissing.forged_maul: A maul pulled glowing from the body of a Gutsu Gutsu no Mi user, like Bill in the Silver Mine arc, and forged from the best metal in the furnace. It sets what it strikes on fire and melts after 90 seconds or when dropped.
lore.inomissing.forged_spear: A spear pulled glowing from the body of a Gutsu Gutsu no Mi user, like Bill in the Silver Mine arc, and forged from the best metal in the furnace. It sets what it strikes on fire and melts after 90 seconds or when dropped.
lore.inomissing.forged_gun: A gun pulled glowing from the body of a Gutsu Gutsu no Mi user, like Bill in the Silver Mine arc, that fires molten metal from the furnace. It sets targets on fire and melts after 90 seconds or when dropped.
lore.inomissing.samurai_helmet: The helmet of the samurai armour conjured by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it protects like iron armour.
lore.inomissing.samurai_cuirass: The cuirass of the samurai armour conjured by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it protects like iron armour.
lore.inomissing.samurai_hakama: The hakama of the samurai armour conjured by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it protects like iron armour.
lore.inomissing.samurai_shin_guards: The shin guards of the samurai armour conjured by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they protect like iron armour.
lore.inomissing.fur_hat: The hat of the warm clothes made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it stops freezing and halves how long frostbite lasts.
lore.inomissing.padded_trousers: The trousers of the warm clothes made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they stop freezing and halve how long frostbite lasts.
lore.inomissing.fur_boots: The boots of the warm clothes made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they stop freezing and halve how long frostbite lasts.
lore.inomissing.bandit_vest: The vest of the bandit garb made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it makes bandits leave you alone until you strike one, and hides your name.
lore.inomissing.bandit_trousers: The trousers of the bandit garb made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they make bandits leave you alone until you strike one, and hide your name.
lore.inomissing.bandit_boots: The boots of the bandit garb made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they make bandits leave you alone until you strike one, and hide your name.
lore.inomissing.revolutionary_cape: The cape of the revolutionary outfit made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it makes Revolutionaries leave you alone until you strike, and hides your name.
lore.inomissing.revolutionary_trousers: The trousers of the revolutionary outfit made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they make Revolutionaries leave you alone until you strike, and hide your name.
lore.inomissing.revolutionary_boots: The boots of the revolutionary outfit made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they make Revolutionaries leave you alone until you strike, and hide your name.
lore.inomissing.shishi_head: The head of the shishi costume made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it makes monsters leave you alone until you strike one, and hides your name.
lore.inomissing.shishi_coat: The coat of the shishi costume made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, it makes monsters leave you alone until you strike one, and hides your name.
lore.inomissing.shishi_trousers: The trousers of the shishi costume made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they make monsters leave you alone until you strike one, and hide your name.
lore.inomissing.shishi_tabi: The tabi of the shishi costume made by the Fuku Fuku no Mi, the fruit of Kin'emon. Worn with the full set, they make monsters leave you alone until you strike one, and hide your name.
lore.inomissing.ink_dango: A dango drawn in ink with the Fude Fude no Mi, the fruit of Kurozumi Kanjuro. It feeds whoever eats it but tastes of ink, and dissolves after a few minutes.
lore.inomissing.biscuit_pretzel: A copy of Pretzel, the sword of Charlotte Cracker, shaped from crushed biscuit by the Bisu Bisu no Mi. It lasts 60 seconds at most and crumbles if it leaves the hand, in water or under rain.
lore.inomissing.hard_biscuit: A biscuit hardened by the Bisu Bisu no Mi, the fruit of Charlotte Cracker, and too hard to eat as it is. Use it on water to soak it soft.
lore.inomissing.soaked_biscuit: A hard biscuit from the Bisu Bisu no Mi, the fruit of Charlotte Cracker, soaked in water until soft. Now it can be eaten.
lore.inomissing.kibi_dango: A dango pulled from the cheek of a Kibi Kibi no Mi user, the fruit of Tama. The animal that eats it serves its maker, and a player who ate a Zoan fruit can no longer harm them.
lore.inomissing.ink_sabre: A sabre drawn in ink with the Fude Fude no Mi, the fruit of Kurozumi Kanjuro. It lasts 60 seconds at most and dissolves if it leaves the hand or touches water.
lore.inomissing.ink_spear: A spear drawn in ink with the Fude Fude no Mi, the fruit of Kurozumi Kanjuro. It is slower than the sabre but reaches further, and dissolves if it leaves the hand or touches water.
lore.inomissing.mira_mirror: A standing mirror laid by a Mira Mira no Mi user, the fruit of Charlotte Brulee. Using it takes its owner into Mirro-World, and it stays until someone breaks it.
lore.inomissing.buku_prison_book: A book of the Buku Buku no Mi, the fruit of Charlotte Mont-d'Or, holding a creature weakened below half health. Use it on the ground to let the creature out, or burn it to free the creature at once.
lore.inomissing.memory_reel: A reel of memories cut with shears by the Memo Memo no Mi, the fruit of Charlotte Pudding, that keeps the anger a creature felt. Hold it and use Paste on another creature to turn that anger on its target.
lore.parallaxcanon.uta_uta_no_mi: Song-Song Fruit. Eaten by Uta in Film: Red, carrying everyone who hears her song into Uta World, a dream concert stage where the singer flies and fights.
lore.parallaxcanon.uo_uo_no_mi_model_dra: Fish-Fish Fruit, Model: Dragon. No confirmed canon user, but its Ryuo form copies Kaido's Azure Dragon, with sustained flight and room for riders. It only works at least 50 blocks above the ground.
lore.parallaxcanon.uo_uo_no_mi_model_sei: Fish-Fish Fruit, Model: Seiryu. Eaten by Kaido of the Beasts Pirates, letting him become a colossal azure dragon.
lore.parallaxcanon.soru_soru_no_mi: Soul-Soul Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom), letting her cut out souls, mend her body with them and give life to Homies like the Sun and the Cloud.
lore.parallaxcanon.soul: A soul cut out of a target by the Soru Soru no Mi of Big Mom. The user spends souls to mend their body.
lore.parallaxcanon.mochi_mochi_no_mi: Mochi-Mochi Fruit. Eaten by Charlotte Katakuri of the Big Mom Pirates, letting him stretch, harden and stick mochi into punches, a Gatling arm and walls. Awakened, it raises rings of Muso Donuts that throw giant arms.
lore.parallaxcanon.wapu_wapu_no_mi: Warp-Warp Fruit. Eaten by Van Augur of the Blackbeard Pirates, letting him teleport himself and others.
lore.parallaxcanon.riki_riki_no_mi: Power-Power Fruit. Eaten by Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates, granting him immense physical strength.
lore.parallaxcanon.tori_tori_no_mi_model: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Nue. No confirmed canon user, granting the form of the nue, a chimera yokai with a monkey's head, tiger's legs and a serpent's tail.
lore.parallaxcanon.hebi_hebi_no_mi_model: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi. Eaten by Kurozumi Orochi, the shogun of Wano, granting an eight-headed serpent form and the extra heads to match.
lore.parallaxcanon.hito_hito_no_mi_model: Human-Human Fruit, Model: Onyudo. Eaten by Onimaru, a fox retainer of Wano's Ringo region, granting the form of a towering monk yokai armed with a naginata and sword.
lore.parallaxcanon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_b: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Bake-Danuki. Grants the shapeshifting form of a mischievous raccoon dog yokai, along with the ability to conjure phantom clones and transform leaves into useful tools.
lore.parallaxcanon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_k: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Kyubi no Kitsune. Eaten by Catarina Devon of the Blackbeard Pirates, granting the form of a nine-tailed fox spirit.
lore.parallaxcanon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_o: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami. Eaten by Yamato, daughter of Kaido, granting the form of a guardian wolf deity.
lore.parallaxcanon.inu_inu_no_mi_model_t: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Tanuki. 'Eaten' by Bunbuku, a teapot belonging to Tenguyama Hitetsu of Wano, giving it life as a raccoon dog.
lore.parallaxcanon.juku_juku_no_mi: Ripe-Ripe Fruit. Eaten by Shinobu, a kunoichi of the Kozuki Family, letting her ripen or wither anything she touches, people included.
lore.parallaxcanon.kibi_kibi_no_mi: Kibi-Kibi Fruit. Eaten by Tama of Wano, letting her befriend and control any animal that eats one of her dango.
lore.parallaxcanon.kumo_kumo_no_mi_model: Spider-Spider Fruit, Model: Rosamygale Grauvogeli. Eaten by Black Maria of the Beasts Pirates, granting the form of a colossal ancient spider.
lore.parallaxcanon.maki_maki_no_mi: Scroll-Scroll Fruit. Eaten by Raizo of the Nine Red Scabbards, letting him seal attacks and objects inside scrolls and release them again.
lore.parallaxcanon.mori_mori_no_mi: Forest-Forest Fruit. Eaten by Admiral Aramaki (Greenbull), turning the user into living wood and a hulking tree golem.
lore.parallaxcanon.neko_neko_no_mi_model: Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Saber Tiger. Eaten by Who's Who of the Big Mom Pirates, granting the form of a saber-toothed tiger.
lore.parallaxcanon.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_p: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Pachycephalosaurus. Eaten by Ulti of the Beasts Pirates, granting a fast, headbutting dinosaur form.
lore.parallaxcanon.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_s: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Spinosaurus. Eaten by Page One of the Beasts Pirates, granting the form of a clawed, crushing-jawed predator.
lore.parallaxcanon.ryu_ryu_no_mi_model_t: Dino-Dino Fruit, Model: Triceratops. Eaten by Sasaki of the Beasts Pirates, granting a heavily armoured, horned dinosaur form.
lore.parallaxcanon.devil_fruit_life: An item with no canon source, letting a Devil Fruit user shrug off death. Each extra life is spent when the user dies, up to a cap.
lore.parallaxcanon.santoryu_trainer_spaw: Spawns a trainer of the Santoryu fighting style, Roronoa Zoro's three-sword technique.
lore.parallaxcanon.nitoryu_trainer_spawn: Spawns a trainer of the Nitoryu fighting style, the two-sword technique of swordsmen like Roronoa Zoro.
lore.parallaxcanon.bludgeon_trainer_spaw: Spawns a trainer of the Bludgeon fighting style, which makes blunt weapons deal 35% more damage.
lore.parallaxcanon.dual_axe_trainer_spaw: Spawns a trainer of the Dual Axe fighting style, in the manner of Scopper Gaban of the Roger Pirates, who wields two axes at once.
lore.parallaxcanon.gaban_axe: One of the twin axes of Scopper Gaban, former member of the Roger Pirates and the Pirate King's left arm.
lore.parallaxcanon.axe_hand: The steel axe that replaces the right hand of Captain 'Axe-Hand' Morgan, the tyrannical Marine of Shell Town.
lore.parallaxcanon.broggy_axe: The huge axe of Brogy, the Red Ogre of the Giant Warrior Pirates of Elbaf.
lore.parallaxcanon.warashi_axe: An axe with no confirmed canon wielder.
lore.parallaxcanon.wetton_axe: The axe of Wetton, the pirate-turned-mayor of Ruluka in the anime-only Ruluka Island arc.
lore.parallaxcanon.meadow_axe: An axe with no confirmed canon wielder.
lore.parallaxcanon.boar_axe: An axe with no confirmed canon wielder.
lore.parallaxcanon.alvida_mace: The iron mace of Alvida, the Iron Mace captain Luffy beat in East Blue.
lore.parallaxcanon.urouge_club: The club of Urouge, the Mad Monk of the Worst Generation.
lore.parallaxcanon.beast_pirate_kanabo: A kanabo carried by the rank-and-file crew of Kaido's Beasts Pirates.
lore.parallaxcanon.jailer_beast_club: The club carried by the Jailer Beasts, the Beasts Pirates guards of the Udon prison.
lore.parallaxcanon.yamato_kanabo: The kanabo of Yamato, Kaido's daughter, who swings it in the style of her father.
lore.parallaxcanon.kaido_kanabo: Kaido's kanabo Hassaikai, the spiked club of the Strongest Creature in the World.
lore.parallaxcanon.starter_sword: A plain sword with no canon owner, for fighters just starting out.
lore.parallaxcanon.starter_pistol: A plain pistol with no canon owner, for fighters just starting out.
lore.parallaxcanon.starter_staff: A plain staff with no canon owner, for fighters just starting out.
lore.parallaxcanon.starter_mace: A plain mace with no canon owner, for fighters just starting out.
lore.parallaxcanon.mortal_blade: A blade with no confirmed canon wielder.
lore.parallaxcanon.rifle: A long-range rifle with no specific canon owner.
lore.parallaxcanon.big_axe: A heavy axe with no confirmed canon wielder.
lore.parallaxcanon.golden_staff: A golden staff with no confirmed canon wielder.
lore.parallaxcanon.clima_tact: The weather-bending staff of Nami, built by Usopp, that gathers the sky's weather into attacks.
lore.parallaxcanon.jitte: A Marine jitte like the one carried by Vice Admiral Smoker, with a Seastone tip.
lore.parallaxcanon.daisenso: A weapon with no confirmed canon wielder.
lore.parallaxcanon.wado_ichimonji: Roronoa Zoro's white-hilted katana, inherited from his childhood rival Kuina.
lore.parallaxcanon.izou_kimono_bottom: The bottom half of the kimono worn by Izo, the 16th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.
lore.parallaxcanon.izou_kimono_top: The top half of the kimono worn by Izo of the Whitebeard Pirates, as sharp in style as he is with a blade.
lore.parallaxcanon.izou_sandals: The sandals worn by Izo, the Whitebeard Pirates' flamboyant swordsman and former Revolutionary Army agent.
lore.parallaxcanon.leaf_sword: A blade conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability, a trick unique to Bake-Danuki transformees. Vanishes once its purpose is served.
lore.parallaxcanon.leaf_axe: An axe conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability. Useful in a pinch, if only briefly.
lore.parallaxcanon.leaf_pickaxe: A pickaxe conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability, courtesy of a Bake-Danuki's shapeshifting magic.
lore.parallaxcanon.leaf_shovel: A shovel conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability. As real as it needs to be, for as long as it's needed.
lore.parallaxcanon.leaf_hoe: A hoe conjured from a leaf via the Leaf of Many Forms ability, the humblest tool a Bake-Danuki can summon from thin air.
